jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Conference &amp; Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)---Conference \& Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)=========================================ab Januar 2027 oder nach VereinbarungConference \& Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)=========================================ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung   Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n:  Ihr umfangreiches Hauptaufgabengebiet umfasst unter anderem:* Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, Erstellung von Angeboten und Verhandlung von Verträgen \- *sei es eine grosse Hochzeit, ein 2\-Personen Meeting, ein Buy\-out oder eine reine Gruppen\-Zimmerbuchung** Bewertung von RFPs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Revenue Management* Kundenberatung, kreative Angebots\-/ Konzepterstellung (*inkl. Durchführung von Probeessen, Locationberatung \& Besichtigungen*)* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem proaktiven MICE und Team zur Steigerung der Lead\-Conversion* Erstellung detaillierter BEOs* Durchführung von BEO Meetings und Gewährleistung einer optimalen bereichsübergreifenden Kommunikation für einen reibungslosen Veranstaltungsablauf* Sicherstellung eines exzellenten Kundenservices vor, während und nach den Veranstaltungen* Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Veranstaltungsablaufs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Bankett Operations\- und den F\&B Teams, sowie alle involvierten operativen Abteilungen* Mitverantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der unterstellten Mitarbeitenden sowie, sowie aktive Mitwirkung an internen AbteilungsschulungenSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung sowie Erfahrung in der gehobenen und internationalen Hotellerie und haben bereits fundierte F\&B Kenntnisse sammeln können. Wir setzen sehr gutes know\-how mit MS Office\- und Hotelreservierungsprogrammen, Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie lösungsorientiertes Verhalten, eine selbständige Arbeitsweise und Detailgenauigkeit voraus. Verantwortungs\- und Organisationsbewusstsein genau wie ein sicheres, freundliches Auftreten, Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch zeichnen Sie aus. Wenn Sie bereits mit OPERA gearbeitet haben, ist dies ein grosses Plus. Sie denken und handeln vernetzt, sind kundenorientiert und erkennen Prioritäten von sich aus.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:   *Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»  Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»     *BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Würzer  HR Business Partner \& Talents  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon**        ******jid7cdc3e3jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Technical Lead, CMS Backend
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Technical Lead, CMS Backend (100%)--- Technical Lead, CMS Backend (100%)==================================Tamedia helps people understand what is happening – locally, within Switzerland, and in the world. Behind every story — the breaking news alert, the long\-form investigation, the live updates during an election night — is our home\-grown CMS, Unity. Unity is constantly evolving and built on Java and Boot, and it's the system that powers our newsrooms.We're looking for a Technical Lead to own Unity’s codebase, architecture and technical roadmap, to lead the four engineers who build it with you, and to collaborate with other teams and product owners. This is a hands\-on engineering role, and you'll also make sure the system, and the team, keep getting better.**What you can expect:*** Own the backend architecture. Our stack is Java 25, Boot 4, JPA, MariaDB, RabbitMQ, and Elasticsearch, among others.* Lead your team of four engineers in Zurich and Belgrade. Grow your people. Provide mentorship, technical coaching and general support for your team. Make sure the team runs smoothly and efficiently.* Be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining performant backend services, APIs, messaging patterns and integration flows* Define code quality standards, best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and keep improving DX.* Modernize what needs it. Parts of the CMS carry real history. Lead refactoring and modernization work that keeps the platform future\-ready — without grinding general delivery to a halt.* Ship faster for editorial. Our newsrooms' needs evolve constantly — new formats, new workflows, AI\-assisted tooling. You'll make sure the backend is an enabler for that, not a bottleneck.* Split your week roughly evenly between hands\-on engineering and leading the team — system design, reviews, pairing, coding, coaching.* Collaborate with other engineers and product owners to gather requirements and design solutions and their roadmap.**We are looking for:*** Deep, hands\-on backend engineering experience, with real technical range: distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, and have the judgment to find the right tools versus resume\-driven designs.* Mastery of Java / Boot / Databases.* Fluency in modern architectural patterns, and overall system performance.* Familiarity with Unix/Linux is a plus.* First leadership experience and a genuine interest in people leadership — coaching and mentoring first, formal management second.* Our technology department functions in English; is useful, but not essential.Unity CMS supports hundreds of journalists every single day.We're a progressive tech org sitting inside a media company navigating real industry pressure — which is part of what makes this interesting. We're integrating AI into our products, we care about good engineering culture, and yes — we still believe good journalism matters for democracy, and that the backend nobody sees is part of what makes that possible.**Benefits:*** Five weeks vacation with option for seven weeks and vacation purchase* Flexible working models and mobile office options (2 days per week at 100%)* Paid day off on birthday* Numerous discounts e.g. cell phone subscription, digital TV, bicycle rental, car purchase* Wide range of free health promotion services (social counseling, health coach app, flu vaccination, various trainings)* Possibility for unpaid vacation up to max. six months* Additional half days off before certain holidays* Referral program: Up to CHF 2'000 reward* Free digital subscriptions and discounted print offers![Tamedia Publikationen Deutschschweiz AG]()* Tamedia Publikationen Deutschschweiz AG  Werdstrasse 21  8004 Zürich*jideb57f88jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Junior Finance Business Analyst & Automation Specialist
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Finance Business Analyst &amp; Automation Specialist---Finance Business Analyst \& Automation Specialist=================================================  **Description**  We are seeking a junior professional with a strong technical background to support the transformation of our finance function into an AI\-enabled, data\-driven organization. In this hands\-on role, you will redesign processes and develop automation and analytics solutions, while building your finance and controlling expertise alongside experienced colleagues in an international asset management environment.Your responsibilities include: *Automation, data and AI** Act as a driving force in the finance team's transition to an AI\-enabled way of working, redesigning and streamlining finance and controlling processes end to end;* Design and implement automation, analytics and AI\-based solutions that reduce manual work, improve data quality and strengthen controls;* Analyze finance processes, define requirements, and identify gaps in functionality and scalability against the finance organization's future ambitions;* Contribute and shape our finance system landscape with a focus on scalable, efficient reporting;* Partner with IT and business teams to build modern, data\-driven solutions that provide faster access to data, enable quicker responses to ad\-hoc requests, and support better decisions. *Reporting and finance** Maintain and enhance management reporting, with a focus on relevance, usability and automation;* Support the maintenance and development of management reporting, with a focus on clear, decision\-relevant insights and increased automation;* Deliver financial analysis and actionable insights for management and business stakeholders;* Play an active role in budgeting, forecasting and financial planning cycles, using data and automation to make them faster and more reliable;* Prepare regular and ad\-hoc analyses, deep dives and scenario assessments that support key business decisions.We offer a hands\-on role in which your technical skills have a direct and visible impact on how our finance function operates. You will have the opportunity to build your finance and controlling expertise on the job, supported by experienced colleagues, and will join a collaborative, international team culture where new ideas are always welcome.   **Requirements*** Degree from a university or university of applied sciences in business informatics, data science, computer science, economics or finance, with a strong quantitative and technical focus;* First professional experience translating technical skills into practical business solutions, ideally in asset management (preferably private markets) or the broader financial services industry;* Hands\-on experience with data and automation tools (e.g., , SQL, Power BI) as well as databases and/or multidimensional cubes* Strong interest in AI\-enabled ways of working and the drive to develop new ideas into end\-to\-end solutions;* Advanced Excel skills and a solid command of the wider Microsoft 365 toolset;* Solid understanding of finance and accounting principles; experience in controlling or reporting tools is an advantage;* Curious, proactive and eager to learn, with a structured and analytical way of working;* Confident collaborating across finance, IT, investment and business development teams, and comfortable encouraging others to embrace new ways of working;* Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical ideas simply and effectively across all levels of the organization; is a strong asset.What you can expect-------------------* We provide **modern working conditions**, including work\-from\-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;* A **diverse culture** founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;*  **We empower and invest in you**: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your or English language skills;* We are proud to be owned by the **Princely Family of Liechtenstein** and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;*  **Commitment to ESG**: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family's long\-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;* You benefit from **favorable terms and conditions** if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners' investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services. **Contact Information**  If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.  For further information please contact us.Human ResourcesLGT Capital Partners AG, PfaeffikonContact: ![LGT Capital Partners AG]()*** ![LGT Capital Partners AG]()***jidca172a8jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: Description de l’entrepriseObserver. Analyser. Comprendre. Améliorer.Dans l'univers de l'étampage, la performance d'un outil ne se mesure pas uniquement sur le papier. jobs.description: Ref 2588336 \\\| Date: 30 Oct 2026 !\[Groupe Manotel\]( ) L'\*\*Hôtel Royal\*\*\\\*\\\*, membre du groupe \*\*Manotel\*\*, est l'une des références de l'hôtellerie genevoise. jobs.description: **Company Description**Van Lanschot Kempen is the leading Dutch private bank with Private Banking as its core and supporting Investment Management and Investment Banking services. jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)--- Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)===============================**Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)**  As Product Owner you run day to day. You are the link between medical expertise and software development: you translate biomarker logic, supplement science and customer needs into clear requirements and work packages, and you make sure what is delivered is correct, safe and useful. You work closely with the Medical Lead, the Strategic Lead and an external development team. **Workload:** 60%**Location:** Zug, Purpur Hub (hybrid possible) \- residence in Switzerland**Start date:** Immediately / by agreement**Reports to:** Strategic Lead is the personal health companion of Tortuga Sense. It turns blood values, personal goals and lifestyle information into a personalized, reasoned supplement recommendation and explains it in plain language. Recommendations are derived from a medically governed rule set; a language model explains them, backed by a curated knowledge base. The product supports prevention and wellbeing. It does not diagnose or treat. The first version is built from October 2026 to January 2027, piloted with 50–100 customers and partners from February to March 2027, and launched in 2027\. **What awaits you*** A key role in building a new health product. From the first version to market launch.* Real product ownership, short decision paths and direct exchange with medical experts, leadership and the development team.* A dynamic start\-up environment at the Purpur Hub in Zug with room for your own ideas.* A flexible, hybrid working model. **Your responsibilities*** Own the product backlog: define features, user stories and acceptance criteria and prioritise them against the agreed scope* Translate the medical rule set (biomarkers, thresholds, supplement and dosage logic) into precise, testable specifications together with the Medical Lead* Design the customer journey with the team: questionnaire and consents, lab report upload, recommendation, report dialogue and history* Help maintain the knowledge base and select, check and reference scientific sources. Review the explanations generated by the language model for scientific accuracy, clarity and compliance (no diagnosis, no therapy recommendation)* Steer sprints with the development partner, perform functional acceptance of all deliveries and coordinate medical sign\-off before release* Plan and run internal testing on real cases and the closed pilot with customers and external partners (e.g. medical practices, pharmacies)* Make sure requirements reflect regulatory boundaries (non\-medical\-device positioning, health claims) and data\-protection needs (consents, sensitive health data)* Monitor the budget against agreed funding, and flag deviations early **What you bring*** Background in life sciences, nutrition science, pharmacy, biomedicine, medicine or comparable practical experience in a health or supplement setting* Solid knowledge in at least one of: dietary supplements and micronutrients, prevention/longevity or laboratory diagnostics. You can read a blood panel and understand biomarkers and reference ranges, or clearly bring the readiness to get up to speed here quickly with the Medical Lead* Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a comparable role, ideally in digital health, health tech or diagnostics* You write clear requirements and user stories and work with developers in an agile setting* A structured, hands\-on way of working; you take decisions and hold scope* Very good English, written and spoken \- English is our working language across the team. is a strong advantage, in particular for the Swiss market and partners **Nice to have*** Experience with lab data, LIS/lab report formats or health data standards (e.g. LOINC, HL7/FHIR)* Experience with AI\-based products, rule engines or clinical decision logic* Knowledge of the regulatory framework for supplements, health claims and medical device software in Switzerland and the EU (e.g. MDR, revFADP/GDPR)* Experience running pilots with health professionals, pharmacies or consumers **What we offer you*** Plenty of personal responsibility and real product ownership in a young, dynamic environment* Direct collaboration with medical experts, leadership and an experienced development team* Short decision paths and room to shape the product* Working at the Purpur Hub in Zug at Grienbachstrasse 17* Market\-standard employment conditions, flexible working hours and the possibility of home office* A collegial working atmosphere on equal footing – your four\-legged friend is warmly welcome in the office **Sound like you?**Then we look forward to your application with your CV and a few lines on your experience with supplements, prevention or diagnostics and with product ownership. For further questions, feel free to reach out directly to us.![Purpur Ventures AG]()* Purpur Ventures AG  Grienbachstrasse 17  6300 Zug*jidb76c79bjm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum - für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum - für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand--- Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum \- für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand=========================================================================Pensioniert mit Mandat? Ihre Erfahrung im Stockwerkeigentum ist gefragt.------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Bewirtschafter/in Stockwerkeigentum – für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand**Sie haben Eigentümergemeinschaften durch hitzige Versammlungen geführt, Sanierungen über die Ziellinie gebracht und Erneuerungsfonds aufgebaut, die heute noch tragen. Diese Erfahrung lässt sich in keinem Kurs lernen. Sie ist das Ergebnis jahrzehntelanger Praxis – und genau darauf setzen wir.Zusammen mit uns bleiben Sie am Ball – so viel und so oft, wie Sie möchten. Keine grossen Portfolios, kein Pflichtprogramm. Sondern einzelne Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften, die Sie mit Ihrer ganzen Erfahrung und in Ihrem Tempo begleiten.ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG ist eine Boutique\-Immobilienbewirtschafterin mit Hauptsitz in Küssnacht am Rigi und einem Standort in Pfäffikon SZ – spezialisiert auf Stockwerkeigentum in der Innerschweiz. Im Generationenwechsel erneuern wir unsere digitale und prozessuale Basis mit Augenmass und entwickeln uns weiter – werden Sie ein Teil davon.### Ihr Wirkungsfeld* Sie betreuen einzelne, ausgewählte Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften im Kanton Schwyz. Wo Sie tätig werden, besprechen wir gemeinsam.* Sie bereiten Eigentümerversammlungen vor, leiten sie mit Ruhe und Souveränität und begleiten die Umsetzung von gefassten Beschlüssen.* Sie begleiten Unterhalt und Sanierungen, beraten zum Erneuerungsfonds und stehen den Verwaltungsausschüssen als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite.* Sie geben Ihr Know\-how an unsere junge Generation von Bewirtschafterinnen und Bewirtschaftern weiter – im gemeinsamen Mandat, an der Versammlung und im täglichen Austausch.* Sie bringen Ihre Sichtweise bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe und Arbeitsmittel ein. Denn Sie wissen aus Erfahrung, was sich in der Praxis bewährt.### Was Sie mitbringen* Langjährige Erfahrung in der Bewirtschaftung von Stockwerkeigentum* Sicherheit in Versammlungsführung, Reglementen und Stockwerkeigentumsrecht* Gelassenheit, wenn es emotional wird, und das Geschick, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen* Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen und junge Kolleginnen und Kollegen in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten* Offenheit für neue Arbeitsweisen und digitale Hilfsmittel. Bei der Einarbeitung unterstützen wir Sie selbstverständlich.### Was wir bieten* **Freiheit in der Zeiteinteilung:** Sie gestalten Ihr Arbeitspensum flexibel und stimmen Ihre Einsätze auf Ihre persönlichen Bedürfnisse und auf die Anforderungen der Eigentümergemeinschaften ab.* **Unsere Infrastruktur, Ihr Rückhalt:**Arbeitssysteme, Vorlagen und ein Team im Hintergrund – Sie müssen nichts selbst aufbauen. Wir richten Ihnen alle Zugänge ein und begleiten Sie persönlich beim Einstieg.* **Homeoffice und Büro:** Sie arbeiten von zu Hause aus und sind bei Bedarf in unseren Büros jederzeit willkommen.* **Ferien ohne schlechtes Gewissen:** Ihre Stellvertretung ist im Team geregelt – auch wenn Sie einmal mehrere Wochen unterwegs sind.* **Ihre Erfahrung zählt:** Wir hören auf Sie. Ihre Ideen und Ihr Urteil fliessen in unsere Arbeit ein.* **Weitergeben, was bleibt:** Sie prägen die nächste Generation der Bewirtschaftung bei ANMAT und sorgen dafür, dass wertvolle Erfahrung und Praxiswissen erhalten bleiben.* **Teil von etwas Neuem:** Gestalten Sie mit, was aus ANMAT im Generationenwechsel wird.* **Faire Konditionen:** Teilzeitanstellung oder Mandat auf Stundenbasis – gut vereinbar als Nebenerwerb neben der Rente. Wir finden die Arbeitsform, die zu Ihrer Situation passt. Ihre Fahrspesen vergüten wir. **Klingt nach Ihnen?**Ein Lebenslauf genügt – oder rufen Sie uns einfach unter an. Ein erstes Gespräch ist bei uns persönlich, offen und unkompliziert. Gerne auch bei einem Kaffee.  **, CEO**  ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG · Bahnhofstrasse 57 · 6403 Küssnacht am Rigi![ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG]()* ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG  Bahnhofstrasse 57  6403 Küssnacht am Rigi*jid2832c1ejm jit1044jm jiy26jm

priorisation selon CISA KEV et EPSS, suivi des correctifs et reporting. jobs.title: Senior Manager, GVP Compliance
jobs.description: About the role- Strengthen key elements of the global Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) compliance framework by executing and maintaining a risk‑based, digitally enabled quality system that is compliant, scalable, and sustainable across Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system.- Contribute to the implementation of an integrated GVP compliance approach in close partnership with the PSPV function and the Center for Continuous Improvement for CTD and PV, supporting aligned quality oversight and effective adoption of regulatory intelligence.- Support the effectiveness of GVP investigations, audits, and inspections by applying robust root‑cause analysis, supporting CAPA execution and compliance monitoring, and contributing to global GVP inspection readiness activities.- Contribute to effective GVP quality governance by supporting monitoring and reporting of GVP compliance risks, trends, and mitigation actions through PSPV governance forums, the R&D Quality risk register, and the Clinical & Safety Quality Council.How you will contribute- Manage and support the operation of the GVP Quality Management System (QMS) by executing review, implementation, and maintenance of standards, policies, and procedures supporting GVP‑regulated activities within PSPV.- Execute core GVP quality system processes including change control, deviations and investigations, incident notification and escalation, and CAPA management, acting as a GVP compliance subject‑matter expert.- Support investigations of significant GVP quality events and deviations, applying root‑cause analysis methodologies to support effective remediation and prevention of recurrence.- Support CAPA lifecycle management, including tracking implementation and effectiveness, monitoring timely completion of actions related to quality events, audits, and inspections, and escalating risks where appropriate.- Support GVP inspection readiness activities, including preparation, coordination, document sup-port, and execution of inspection activities using established processes and available technologies.- Support assigned GVP regulatory inspections, including inspection preparation, hosting support, response development, tracking of commitments, risk escalation, and mitigation activities in collaboration with cross‑functional stakeholders.- Support strategic quality oversight of PV suppliers, including review of Quality Agreements, participation in supplier governance activities, and escalation of identified compliance risks in partner-ship with PSPV.- Provide GVP compliance review and quality input to Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs), ensuring alignment with applicable global GVP regulations and Takeda standards, and escalating identified gaps, risks, or ambiguities to senior GVP Compliance leadership as appropriate.- Contribute GVP quality and compliance data to the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), supporting the accurate reflection of Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system, processes, governance, and oversight framework.- Ensure consistency between PSPV quality system documentation, PVAs, and the PSMF, identifying inconsistencies or emerging risks and supporting corrective actions to maintain regulatory alignment and inspection readiness.- Support responses to regulatory authority requests related to the PSMF and PVAs, including preparation of supporting documentation and evidence in collaboration with PSPV, R&D Quality, and Global Regulatory stakeholders.- Contribute to quality governance activities, including preparation of materials and inputs for Management Review and the Clinical & Safety Quality Council related to GVP compliance.- Provide support for Global Quality internal audits and Business Alliance audits across Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system, including preparation, coordination, response support, and CAPA follow‑up.Skills and qualifications- Scientific or allied health qualification (BSc required; Master’s/PhD strongly preferred).- Experience (5+ years) in the global pharmaceutical industry in PV and Quality and Compliance roles (3+ years).- Strong working knowledge and understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations including ICH Pharmacovigilance Guidelines (E2 Series), EMA Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) Directives and Modules,  US Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), FAERS and Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS), Japan PMDA & MHLW GVP Ordinance and Good Post‑Marketing Study Practice (GPSP) Ordinance, Health Canada, World Health Organization (WHO) global multinational framework for International Drug Monitoring and those in countries such as China (NMPA PV), India (PvPI), etc.- Experience in supporting GVP audits and regulatory inspections, investigations and remediation.- Strong attention to detail with a quality and compliance mindset.- Ability to operate effectively in cross‑functional, matrixed environments.- Solid analytical and problem‑solving skills.- Clear written and verbal communication skills.- Ability to manage priorities and execute under timelines.- Professional judgment with willingness to escalate risks appropriately.- Integrity‑driven and patient‑focused approach aligned with Takeda values.

jobs.title: System Support Engineer
jobs.description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a:**System Support Engineer**As a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in\-vitro diagnostics, the Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalization and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness.The RDS R\&D organization operates globally, with international teams across various sites and countries, and is structured into four networks and four chapter areas. We are currently seeking a passionate and proactive individual to fill the role of System Support Engineer within the R\&D Service chapter, located in Rotkreuz, Switzerland.As a System Support Engineer, you will be a key technical expert within a cross\-functional environment, responsible for supporting Roche Diagnostic Systems throughout their entire lifecycle, from development to post\-launch.**Tasks \& Responsibilities*** Serve as a technical expert and primary point of contact for internal customers regarding all service aspects.* Install Roche Diagnostics systems, including hardware and software, across all development phases, including early prototypes, as well as according to installation manuals in the Roche Diagnostics Knowledge (RDK) database.* Perform system qualifications (IQ/OQ), execute preventive maintenance, and conduct autonomous troubleshooting and repair of hardware and software issues.* Manage the deployment and servicing of various systems and their specific configurations.* Ensure comprehensive documentation in accordance with established quality standards.* Provide technical support for global development trials.**Must\-Haves*** HF or university degree in an engineering or life sciences discipline, such as medical devices, electronics and automation, or mechatronics, or completed technical vocational training with relevant practical experience.* Initial experience in, or a clear willingness to work in, a highly regulated industry and in laboratories with biosafety levels S1 and S2\.* First hands\-on experience in a technical or mechanical occupation.* Customer\- and service\-oriented team player with strong communication and collaboration skills, featuring an autonomous and proactive work style.* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. German is an advantage for the Rotkreuz site.**Nice\-to\-Haves*** Basic knowledge of network administration and IT troubleshooting.* Prior experience servicing diagnostic instruments or involvement in equipment management.* Practical experience resolving technical issues across interdisciplinary setups, including hardware, software and laboratory workflows.* Previous experience working in a GMP\- or ISO\-regulated environment.**What We Offer*** The opportunity to work for one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.* A modern campus with extensive green spaces and meeting areas.* A central location with easy access to the motorway and a nearby train station.* A varied range of responsibilities.* Home office opportunities.* Further training opportunities through temptraining.* The opportunity to work in a dynamic and motivated team.* Good compensation.Please send your complete application documents to Ms Nadine Rutz.Chemistry, Pharmaceuticals, Pharmacy, Diagnostics, Zug, Lucerne, Full\-time, Research, Laboratoryj4id10461688jm j4it1044jm j4iy26jm

jobs.description: Lager- och packmedarbetare till Pickmix Candy SwedenPickmix Candy Sweden är ett växande e-handelsföretag med försäljning i Sverige och internationellt. Vi söker nu fler medarbetare till vårt lager i Hjo.Om tjänstenSom lager- och packmedarbetare arbetar du främst med att plocka, väga och paketera godis och andra produkter inför leverans. Arbetet sker tillsammans med övriga medarbetare på lagret och leds av vår teamledare.Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:    Plockning, vägning och paketering av godis.    Förberedelse av beställningar och leveranser.    Påfyllning och organisering av produkter.    Övriga förekommande arbetsuppgifter inom lager och paketering.Vi arbetar med tydliga mål där både noggrannhet, kvalitet och ett bra arbetstempo är viktiga delar av arbetet.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs med ett praktiskt arbete. Du arbetar effektivt, har lätt för att samarbeta och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.Vi värdesätter också att du är social, positiv och bidrar till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen. För oss är personlig lämplighet, engagemang och inställning till arbetet viktigare än tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.Du behöver inte ha arbetat med liknande arbetsuppgifter tidigare. Du får den introduktion och upplärning som behövs för att komma in i arbetet.Vad erbjuder vi?Vi erbjuder ett varierande arbete i ett växande företag där samarbete, ansvar och arbetsglädje är viktiga delar av vardagen.Tjänsten är placerad i Hjo och anställningen sker hos SR Trading AB, företaget bakom Pickmix Candy Sweden.Omfattning: Heltid eller deltid enligt överenskommelseLön: Månads- eller timlön med möjlighet till prestationsbaserad bonusTillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelseAnsökanVi söker flera medarbetare och genomför intervjuer löpande. jobs.title: Vi søker deg med hjerte for mat. mennesker og kvalitet
jobs.description:
Vi du lede et kjøkken som skaper matglede, gode måltidsopplevelser og trygg næring hver dag? Vi søker en engasjert og utviklingsorientert leder som ønsker å bidra til kvalitet, trivsel og god ressursutnyttelse. Som avdelingsleder for kjøkkenet får du ansvar for den daglige driften av kjøkkenet og blir en viktig del av ledertaemet. Du vil lede dyktige medarbeidere og videreutvikle er kjøkken som har stor betydning for pasientenes helse, livskvalitet og måltidsglede. Hos oss handler mat om mer enn ernæring. Måltidene er dagens høydepunkt for mange av våre beboere. Som kjøkkenleder får du muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell hver eneste dag.

På Nygård BBS Kjøkken vil du møte en aktiv og sammensveiset gjeng som ikke står av veien for å ta i et tak. Kjøkkenet produserer måltider til Nygård BBS, Sandefjord Medisinske Senter (SMS), Bofellesskap og Dagsenter. Vi drifter Kafé Nygård og kantinen på SMS, samt noe catering.  Kjøkkenet leverer mat til personer med sammensatte og ulike ernæringsmessige behov, og har kompetanse på formkost og dietter. Hos oss får du kombinere ledelse, fagutvikling og matglede med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Her ser du noen av de flotte medarbeiderne du vil møte:

Nygård BBS er nylig påbygd og renovert, og nyoppusset kjøkken med moderne utstyr ble åpnet i mars 2023. Sykehjemmet har 162 beboere, og ca 400 ansatte. Dette vil øke gradvis de nærmeste årene, inntil vi når 180 beboere i 2030. Sandefjord Medisinske senter har 61 sengeplasser inne korttid rehabilitering, intermediær, ØHD og palliasjon. Kjøkkenet består av disse to lokasjonene og drives med 9 årsverk inkludert avdelingsleder. Hovedkjøkkenet produserer middager etter kok/kjølprinsippet, inkludert dietter og formkost. I tillegge produseres desserter, kaker og mat til arrangementer og høytider.  I kafé og kantine selges varm og kald mat i ukedagene. Kjøkkenet leverer også bestillinger til møter og catering.

Som leder på kjøkkente har du ansvar for hele verdikjeden innen mat og servering, fra innkjøp, bestilling og lagerstyring til produksjon og distribusjon. Du har personalansvar og resultatansvar innenfor ditt område, og samarbeider tett med verneombud og tillitsvalgte i tråd med virksomhetens satsingsområde. 

Stillingen er under utvikling og det kan bli noe endringer i ansvarsområder i framtiden. 

Mer om Nygård BBS, Sandefjrod Medisinske senter og seksjon Bo- og behandlingssenter kan du lese lenger nede i annonsen. 

Stillingsinformasjon

Stillingsstørrelse: 100%Stillingstype: FastArbeidstid: Per tiden dagtidStilling ledig fra: Etter avtale

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Daglig og administrativ ledelse av kjøkkenet
  • Personalansvar for kjøkkenets medarbeidere
  • Planlegging og oppfølging av produksjon, bemanning og drift
  • Sikre god kvalitet, matsikkerhet og ernæringsfaglige standarder
  • Budsjett- og økonomioppfølging
  • Bidra til utvikling av tjenester, arbeidsprosesser og måltidskonsepter
  • Nært samarbeide og aktiv involvering av verneombud og tillitsvalgt
  • Samarbeide tett med avdelinger, ledere, beboere og pårørende

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant utdanning innen matfag, ernæring eller kokkefag
  • Ledererfaring eller ønske om å ta steget imm i en lederrolle
  • Gjerne videreutdanning innen ledelse
  • God forståelse for økonomi, drift og ressursstyring
  • Er strukturert, tydelig og løsningsorientert
  • Evner å motivere medarbeidere og skape et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Interesse for ernæring og måltidenes betydning i eldreomsorgen
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Førerkort for bil

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende lederstilling med stor påvirkningsmulighet
  • Et viktig samfunnsoppdrag med fokus på kvalitet og matglede
  • Dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere
  • Mulighet til å utvikle og forme fremtidens kjøkkentjenester
  • Lederstøtte og faglige utviklingsmuligheter
  • Bedriftsidrettslag med bredt utvalg og sosiale treff
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Personalhytter

Lønn og pensjon

Stillingen er plassert i kommunens lønnsregulativ i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale og i stillingskode 9453.

Årslønn i stillingen er kr 700 000 for full stilling.

All tidligere privat og offentlig tjeneste godskrives i lønnsansienniteten.

Som ansatt er du medlem av Sandefjord kommunale pensjonskasse og trekkes 2 % i arbeidstakerandel. Arbeidsgiverandelen er p.t. på ca 10 %.

Andre opplysninger

  • Gjensidig prøvetid er 6 måneder. Der arbeidsforholdet er på under 12 mnd, er prøvetiden halvparten av tilsettingstiden.
  • For stillinger der det er krav om politiattest, må godkjent attest fremvises før ansettelse.
  • Kommunen følger offentlighetsloven § 25 ved eventuell offentliggjøring av søkerliste.
  • For å ivareta habilitet og et godt arbeidsmiljø, bør nære relasjoner mellom ansatte på samme tjenestested unngås, særlig der det foreligger over- eller underordetforhold, jf kommunens etiske reglement. 
  • Du skal ikke sende inn vitnemål og attester i forbindelse med søknaden, vi etterspør dette senere i prosessen.

Mangfold og inkludering

Sandefjord kommune arbeider for et mangfoldig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, og ønsker medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, bakgrunn og erfaring. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion, funksjonsevne eller seksuell orientering. Ved ellers like kvalifikasjoner kan søkere av det underrepresenterte kjønnet bli prioritert, i tråd med likestillings‑ og diskrimineringsloven.

Om Nygård BBS, Sandefjord Medisinske Senter og seksjon Bo- og behandlingssentre

Nygård BBS har i dag 162 plasser fordelt på 8 avdelinger. I løpet av de nærmeste årene øker dette til 180 plasser fordelt på 9 avdelinger. De ulike avdelingene er tilrettelagt for personer med demens og somatisk sykdom, med noen plasser for rullerende avlastning. Bygget er nyrenovert i kombinasjon med nybygg og det er satset på teknologi som en naturlig del i utviklingen av tjenesten. Vi har fokus på fagutvikling, miljøarbeid og aktivitet gjennom å se og tilrettelegge for den enkelte beboers behov. Gruppeaktiviteter tilbys i samarbeid med miljøarbeidere og frivillige. Vårt eget produksjonskjøkken har en viktig rolle i arbeidet med matglede og ernæring. Lege er tilknyttet senteret.

Sandefjord Medisinske senter har tre døgnavdelinger som tar imot pasienter fra både spesialisthelsetjenesten og hjemmet, for korttidsopphold med oppfølging, behandling og rehabilitering. I samme bygning holder også legevakt, fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten og lærings- og mestringssenteret til. Auditorium og møterom innbyr til kurs- og møtevirksomhet. Kjøkkenet leverer mat til døgnavdelingene, drifter kantine, møtemat og catering. 

Seksjon bo- og behandlingssentre i Sandefjord kommune består av flere enheter med pasienter på forskjellig omsorgsnivå innen eldreomsorg. Bo- og behandlingssentre er lokalisert med ett i Andebu, ett i Stokke, to i Sandefjord samt  Sandefjord Medisinske senter og tre bofellesskap for mennesker med demenssykdom i Sandefjord. Til sammen 324 plasser fordelt på korttid/avlastning og langtidsplasser. Bo- og behandlingssenterne har egne produksjonskjøkken. Sandefjord kommune er vertskommune for Utviklingssenter for sykehjem og hjemmetjenester i Vestfold, og har stort fokus på fagutvikling og tjenesteutvikling innen eldreomsorgen i kommunen.

jobs.title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

  • Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

  • Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

  • Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

  • Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

  • Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

  • Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

  • Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

  • Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

  • Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

  • Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

  • Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

  • Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

  • Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

  • Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

  • Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

  • Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

  • Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings.

  • Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

  • Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

  • Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity.

  • Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

  • Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

  • Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

  • Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

  • Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Security and Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

  • Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

  • Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

  • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

  • Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

  • Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

    • Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

  • Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

  • Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

  • 175 Mio. Euro Finanzierung im Januar 2026 bei einer Bewertung von 3,5 Mrd. Euro. Zu unseren Investoren zählen TCV, Blackstone, Sequoia, DST Global, CapitalG und Meritech.

  • Expansion in Europa: Seit Ende 2025 sind wir in Deutschland aktiv. Die Einführung der E-Rechnung gibt der Digitalisierung des Finanzwesens zusätzlichen Rückenwind.

Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit.

Warum wir dich suchen

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Als Paid Marketing Manager Germany übernimmst du unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise von der Strategie bis zur Optimierung. Du machst aus Werbebudget qualifizierte Leads und behältst dabei die Kundenakquisekosten im Blick.

Deine Mission

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen.

Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad. Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager.

  • Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

  • Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen.

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

  • Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

  • Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

  • Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du kannst den deutschen Markt eigenständig steuern und arbeitest erfolgreich mit einem verteilten, überwiegend in Frankreich ansässigen Team zusammen.


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up oder einem anderen stark wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen B2B-, Fintech- oder Buchhaltungsmarkts.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Tracking, etwa Tags, Data Layer und Conversions API, um dich mit Growth Engineering auf Augenhöhe auszutauschen.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £35,000 - £45,000

  • Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books


Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.
