Un tableau avec un suivi précis te sera remis pour assurer la montée en compétence et la compréhension de nos process.

Mais on ne s’arrête pas là car la formation est en continue sur le poste de travail pour arriver à l’autonomie.

Et lorsque tu maitriseras les process, nous te proposerons de travailler sur ton planning officieil. Tu auras 2 jours de repos en semaine et tu travailleras tous les samedis et dimanches. L'amplitude horaire est de 7h ce qui correspond à un temps plein de 35h hebdomadaires. Les horaires seront de 14h à 21h le plus souvent et de 6h à 13h lorsque cela sera necessaire.

Note bien qu'avant de postuler, tu a réfléchi au fait de travailler tous les week-ends d'après midi et d'avoir pour jour de repos les lundis et les mardis.

Vos missions

  • En tant que télé-opérateur(trice), vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans notre équipe en garantissant un service de qualité à nos clients.

  • Vos missions incluent :

  • Accueil téléphonique chaleureux : Vous serez le premier point de contact pour nos clients, assurant une expérience accueillante et professionnelle.

  • Réponses adaptées : Vous répondez aux demandes des clients en vous adaptant à chaque situation, en fournissant des informations claires et précises.

  • Traitement des commandes : Vous traitez et saisissez les commandes, qu'il s'agisse d'appels directs ou de réservations, avec efficacité et rigueur.

  • Dispatch des commandes : Vous serez responsable de la répartition des commandes afin d'assurer un service fluide et rapide.

  • Gestion des imprévus : En cas de problème technique, vous veillerez à maintenir la continuité du service, garantissant ainsi la satisfaction de nos clients.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience significative : Vous devez avoir une expérience solide en tant que télé-opérateur(trice).

  • Maîtrise de la langue française : Une excellente communication en français est essentielle.

  • Aptitude informatique : Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils informatiques pour traiter efficacement les demandes.

jobs.title: Quantum Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers.

This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers.
  • Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment.
  • Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs.
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software.

How You’ll Grow:

  • 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve
  • 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
  • 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.

Requirements

What we're looking for: 

  • Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
  • 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.

Must-have: 

  • A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
  • Strong proficiency in python.
  • Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here: 

  • Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
  • Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
  • Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.
  • Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

jobs.title: Photonic Integrated Circuit Designer Intern (H1/2027)
jobs.description:
About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements

  • Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement.
  • Minimal duration is 5 months. Shorter internship will not be accepted.
  • Ideal starting date late Summer 2026.
  • General knowledge of integrated photonics modelling and layout
  • Python, Git, Lumerical, simulation tools (FDTD, mode solver, EME..)
  • Great skills in data analysis
  • Capability of working in a team
  • Strong communication skills in English and French

Benefits

  • Swile Card (meal vouchers) 🍴🛒

  • Possibility of remote work 💻
  • Internship Allowance between €1,200 and €1,400 per month 💰

What we also offer

A challenging and innovative work environment at the heart of quantum computing. 

A diverse and collaborative company culture. 

Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.

Vi värdesätter initiativförmåga, samarbete och viljan att utveckla affärer.Steelcenter ingår i Inev AB – en svensk företagsgrupp med stark entreprenörsanda och långsiktigt fokus på lönsamma, hållbara industribolag. Koncernen ger oss stabilt ägande, ett värdefullt nätverk och strategiskt stöd. Vi delar värderingar som affärsmässighet, långsiktighet och entreprenörskap.Läs mer på: www.steelcenter.se och www.inev.seSök rollen redan idag!Du är varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil. jobs.title: Marketing Lead - B2B Demand Generation & Growth (m/w/d) - Remote
jobs.description:
Über uns

ZEP ist eine cloudbasierte Software für Projektcontrolling – von der Projektzeiterfassung über Abwesenheitsverwaltung bis zur Abrechnung. Mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen, vor allem projektorientierte Dienstleister wie Beratungen, IT- und Engineering-Unternehmen, arbeiten bereits mit ZEP.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2000 sind wir inhabergeführt und kontinuierlich gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und noch mehr Unternehmen von ZEP überzeugen. Als Marketing Lead entwickelst du die passenden Ideen und Maßnahmen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und unser Wachstum aktiv voranzutreiben.

Du willst Marketing nicht nur umsetzen, sondern verantworten – mit klaren Pipeline-Zielen, eigenem Budget und einem Team, das du weiterentwickelst?

Als Marketing Lead bei ZEP übernimmst du die Ergebnisverantwortung für unser Marketing und die daraus entstehende Pipeline. Du führst das Marketingteam sowie unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, steuerst das Marketingbudget und greifst aktiv ein, wenn Zahlen vom Plan abweichen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität dort, wo es darauf ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unsere Pipeline-Ziele und das Marketingbudget und steuerst aktiv gegen, wenn Zahlen abweichen.

  • Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung, schärfst Positionierung und Messaging für unsere B2B-Zielgruppen und leitest daraus Ziele und Prioritäten ab.

  • Als Teil des Management-Teams bringst du die Marketingperspektive in strategische Entscheidungen auf Unternehmensebene ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von ZEP aktiv mit.

  • Du führst das Marketingteam, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Teammitglieder fachlich und persönlich weiter.

  • Du steuerst und forderst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister – insbesondere im Paid-Bereich (z. B. Google Ads, Paid Social) – mit klaren Zielen und Briefings und misst sie an ihren Ergebnissen.

  • Du baust Demand Generation über mehrere Kanäle auf, nicht nur über Paid.

  • Du verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb die Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Sales.

  • Du sorgst für sauberes Tracking und Attribution über den gesamten Funnel.

  • Du wertest Kampagnen, Funnel und Conversion Rates aus – wenn nötig selbst in HubSpot und im Tracking – und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

  • Du entwickelst SEO und die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchen (AI Search) als wachsenden Kanal weiter.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Website weiter und holst mehr Leads aus dem vorhandenen Traffic.

Deine Voraussetzungen

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit, mit Schwerpunkt Demand Generation.

  • Du hast nachweislich Pipeline- oder Umsatzziele erreicht und hattest Budgetverantwortung.

  • Du hast bereits Führungserfahrung gesammelt: Du hast ein Marketingteam geführt, Prioritäten gesetzt und Mitarbeitende weiterentwickelt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Agenturen und Dienstleister zu steuern und fachlich zu fordern.

  • Du kennst dich mit Performance Marketing (Google Ads, Paid Social) so gut aus, dass du Agenturen auf Augenhöhe führst.

  • Du bist sicher in Analyse, Tracking und Attribution; idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit HubSpot.

  • Du setzt KI selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit ein und weißt, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt.

  • Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher verständigen.

Deine Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und unbefristete Arbeitsverträge

  • Remote First Company – Arbeite innerhalb Deutschlands von wo du möchtest!

  • Unterstützung bei der Home-Office Einrichtung

  • Chancen, Freiheiten und Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines Startups verbunden mit der Sicherheit eines seit über 20 Jahren etablierten Unternehmens im Mittelstand.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Keine Kernarbeitszeiten, stimme dich einfach mit dem Team ab.

  • Windows oder Mac? Entscheide selbst!

  • 50 EUR monatlicher Gutschein für verschiedene Sachbezüge oder Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

  • Jobrad mit Arbeitgeber-Zuschuss

  • offene team- und ergebnisorientierte Kultur

  • regelmäßige Workshops, Mittagessen und Events zum Teambuilding

  • Individuelle Altersvorsorgepläne

Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest und diesen Bereich aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Senior SAP FICO Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. 

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. 

As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. 

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective 

About the Role

  • Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. 
  • Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. 
  • Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. 
  • Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. 
  • Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. 
  • Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. 
  • Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4HANA), with a strong focus on Finance (FI/CO) and Procurement (MM).
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Additional working knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and Asset Management modules. 
  • At least two full end-to-end SAP implementations, ideally in a company of similar size and complexity to Flix. 
  • Solid understanding of core finance and procurement processes: General Ledger, Accounts Payable / Receivable, Fixed Assets, Controlling, Purchase-to-Pay. 
  • Experience working with external system integrators and the confidence to engage with them as an equal partner. 
  • Comfortable engaging with senior Finance and Procurement stakeholders and translating between business and SAP language. 
  • Structured, pragmatic, delivery-oriented; strong communication and facilitation skills. 
  • Based in Germany, you're fluent in German and English. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

jobs.title: Fysioterapeut till rehabiliteringsgruppen inom vård och omsorg
jobs.description: Som medarbetare i Bjurholms kommun spelar du en viktig roll där du varje dag är med och formar vår gemensamma framtid.I ditt arbete får du möjlighet att möta människor och uppleva glädjen i att göra skillnad. Inför framtiden behöver vi fler duktiga och engagerade medarbetare som vill vara med och utveckla våra verksamheter. Vi står inför många spännande utmaningar och söker dig som kan ta initiativ, brinner för ditt uppdrag och gärna delar med dig av din kunskap.Tillsammans bidrar vi till en välfärd för Bjurholms cirka 2 400 invånare. I våra verksamheter arbetar omkring 350 personer inom olika yrken och samverkan sker med kommuner inom Umeåregionen. I Bjurholm finns ett gott näringslivsklimat och en god lokal service. Med närhet till vacker natur och aktiviteter inom fritid och kultur är Bjurholm en plats där det är lätt att trivas.BeskrivningDu jobbar med personer som befinner sig inom särskilt boende eller personer som har insatser i hemsjukvård. Du kommer ha en ledande roll som fysioterapeut där du är en del av ett team med två arbetsterapeuter. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för rehabinsatser i särskilt boende och hemsjukvård. Rehabgruppen jobbar tätt med sjuksköterskor inom SÄBO och hemsjukvård. ArbetsuppgifterFörebygga, lösa och mildra de begränsningar som en sjukdom eller skada kan innebära i vardagen. Du kommer vara spindeln i nätet i framtagandet av rutiner och riktlinjer. Du koordinerar och följer upp rutiner och verksamhetsträffar. KvalifikationerVi vill att du är legitimerad fysioterapeut. Erfarenhet av kommunal verksamhet samt erfarenhet av arbete inom vård och omsorg är meriterande. Du arbetar självständigt och fattar egna beslut men har en god förmåga att samarbeta och pedagogiskt dela med dig av kunskap och information. Vi söker dig med starkt intresse för att verksamhetsutveckling och att arbeta med ständiga förbättringar för våra äldre och funktionshindrade. Som person är du är engagerad, lyhörd, kommunikativ och har ett gott bemötande. Du har en god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift samt god datavana. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. B-körkort är ett krav.Övrig informationLön enligt avtal. Urval samt intervjuer sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan på en gång! Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Bjurholms kommun gör inför varje rekrytering ett aktivt val av annonsplats och eventuellt rekryteringsstöd. Vi kontaktar själva de vi väljer att annonsera hos. Därför undanber vi oss alla erbjudanden om köp av annonsplats eller rekryteringsstöd. Vi ber om respekt för detta.

jobs.title: Vil du forme dataarkitekturen for Skatteetatens data- og analyseplattform?
jobs.description:
Data er en strategisk ressurs for Skatteetaten.

Vi har et stort og viktig samfunnsoppdrag og bygger videre på vår satsing innen data, analyse og kunstig intelligens. Vi videreutvikler en felles data- og analyseplattform som skal gjøre det enklere å utvikle, dele og gjenbruke data og dataprodukter på tvers av organisasjonen.

Som senior dataarkitekt vil du få en sentral rolle i utviklingen av dataarkitekturen for data- og analyseplattformen. Du vil bidra til å utvikle faglig retning, prinsipper og arkitekturmønstre og sikre sammenheng på tvers av team, produkter og fagmiljøer. Rollen krever at du kan balansere strategisk retning, arkitekturfaglige avklaringer og praktisk gjennomføring.

Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med blant annet data engineers som jobber tett på utviklingen av dataprodukter og løsninger i teamene. Som dataarkitekt vil du samarbeide tett med disse miljøene for å sikre at arkitekturvalg, prinsipper og mønstre fungerer og kan realiseres i praksis.

Vi videreutvikler hvordan vi arbeider med dataarkitektur i Skatteetaten. Samtidig pågår det et arbeid med å videreutvikle organiseringen av data, analyse og KI i etaten. Som senior dataarkitekt vil du få gode muligheter til å påvirke både dataarkitekturen og hvordan vi samarbeider om dataarkitektur på tvers av organisasjonen.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Du vil blant annet:

  • utvikle og videreutvikle målbilder, prinsipper, referansearkitektur og relevante arkitekturmønstre for dataarkitekturen på data- og analyseplattformen, i samspill med løsningsarkitekt, virksomhetsarkitektur, informasjonsarkitektur og øvrig relevant IT-arkitektur.
  • bidra til utvikling og videreutvikling av dataprodukter og løsninger, og sikre at arkitekturvalg kan realiseres i praksis.
  • bidra til å utvikle og videreutvikle standarder for metadata, sporbarhet, datakvalitet og dokumentasjon.
  • bidra til harmonisering og standardisering av datastrukturer og realisering av vedtatte begreps- og informasjonsmodeller i datamodeller og dataprodukter.
  • bistå team med arkitekturfaglige avklaringer og løsningsdesign og bidra til å redusere teknisk gjeld.
  • samarbeide tett med informasjonsarkitekter, domenearkitekter, løsningsarkitekt, produkteiere, utviklingsteam og andre relevante fagmiljøer.
Hvilken kompetanse er viktig i denne rollen?
  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen informatikk, informasjonsteknologi eller tilsvarende relevant utdanning for arbeidsoppgavene.
  • minimum 5 års relevant erfaring innen dataarkitektur, data engineering eller tilsvarende fagområde, inkludert relevant erfaring med arkitekturarbeid inngår.
  • erfaring med dataarkitektur i en større eller kompleks virksomhet, på tvers av team, produkter eller fagmiljøer.
  • erfaring med datamodellering og dataproduktutvikling.
  • erfaring med moderne skybaserte data- og analyseplattformer, for eksempel Databricks eller lignende
  • forståelse for datastyring og informasjonsforvaltning, herunder metadata, datakvalitet og sporbarhet.
  • erfaring med å forstå og omsette virksomhetsbehov til arkitekturvalg, prinsipper, standarder og tekniske løsninger.
  • god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk.

Fordel med, ikke må-krav:

  • erfaring med distribuerte databehandlingsrammeverk som Apache Spark.
  • erfaring med Data Mesh eller tilsvarende tilnærminger for organisering og forvaltning av data og dataprodukter.
  • erfaring med å tilrettelegge data og dataprodukter for bruk i analyse- og KI-løsninger
  • erfaring med CI/CD-prinsipper og automatisering knyttet til dataplattformer og dataprodukter.
  • erfaring med faglig ledelse, mentoransvar eller deltakelse i arkitekturforum.
Hvem er du?

Du:

  • evner å analysere behov og se sammenhenger mellom forretning, informasjon, data og teknologi.
  • kan omsette behov fra ulike fagmiljøer til tydelige arkitekturfaglige vurderinger og anbefalinger.
  • tilpasser kommunikasjonen til ulike målgrupper og evner å forankre anbefalinger og skape oppslutning om felles løsninger.
  • kombinerer strategisk tenkning med praktisk gjennomføring.
Hvorfor skal du velge oss?

Høres det givende ut å jobbe et sted med et inspirerende samfunnsoppdrag? Da tror vi du vil trives hos oss! Vi kan friste med muligheten til å jobbe med samfunnsaktuelle saker i en nytenkende organisasjon som høster stor tillit i befolkningen. Du får jobbe tverrfaglig med kollegaer fra andre fagområder, og med store muligheter til å planlegge egen arbeidsdag.

Hos oss får du rammer som sikrer deg en fornuftig balanse mellom jobb og fritid: du får fleksitid og betalt overtid, sommertid, samt mulighet for å trene litt i arbeidstiden. Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse følger også med. Det betyr blant annet at du får en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger og mulighet til å søke om boliglån med gunstige betingelser. Les mer på spk.no.

Vi vet at mange ønsker seg en hybrid og fleksibel arbeidshverdag med muligheter for å veksle mellom å jobbe hjemmefra og møtes på kontoret. Det vil vi selvsagt tilrettelegge for. Hos oss kan man inngå avtale om hjemmearbeid når arbeidsoppgavene tilsier at det lar seg gjøre.

Du blir ansatt som senioringeniør, med en årslønn mellom kr 1.000 000 og 1.150 000, avhengig av kvalifikasjonene dine. For spesielt kvalifiserte kan høyere lønn vurderes.

Stillingen har seks måneders prøvetid, og når vi jobber på tvers av flere lokasjoner kan det noen ganger være nødvendig å reise litt.

Verdt å merke seg før du søkerVi er mer opptatt av hva du kan, dine erfaringer og kompetanse enn hvor flink du er til å skrive en jobbsøknad. Derfor ber vi deg om å levere en god og beskrivende CV hvor du får frem hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen du søker på. Du trenger altså ikke å skrive eller legge ved et søknadsbrev.

Vi vil at du skal føle deg trygg på valget når du takker ja til å jobbe hos oss. Dersom du er aktuell for stillingen, tilbyr vi deg en omvendt referansesjekk. Det betyr at du får ringe noen av våre medarbeidere og stille de spørsmålene du måtte ønske for å finne bedre ut om vi er en god match.

Vi er på jobb for alle og skal være et godt sted å jobbe for alle. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel. Har du hull i CV-en din, funksjonsnedsettelse eller innvandrerbakgrunn vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker stillingen hos oss. Det gir deg mulighet for å få positiv særbehandling. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert kandidat fra hver av disse gruppene til intervju.

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor du ønsker det, og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det, hører du selvsagt fra oss.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

De største samfunnsutfordringene krever forskjellige hoder, forskjellige måter å tenke på og at forskjellige fagområder jobber sammen. Når flinke folk fra ulike fagområder jobber sammen, finner vi smartere løsninger som sikrer et velfungerende skattesystem. Vi består av et direktorat, fem divisjoner som har landsdekkende ansvar, og viktigst av alt: litt over 7 000 medarbeidere fra forskjellige fagområder med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, måter å tenke på og perspektiver. Vil du bli enda bedre kjent med oss kan du lese mer på skatteetaten.no

jobs.title: Psykiatrisk sykepleier – psykisk helse og rus
jobs.employer: RØYRVIK KOMMUNE HELSE- OG SOSIALSJEFENS KONTOR
jobs.description:
Røyrvik kommune søker en engasjert og faglig trygg medarbeider til en spennende og variert stilling innen psykisk helse og rus. Stillingen består av 60 % fast stilling og 40 % prosjektstilling knyttet til utvikling av lavterskeltilbud innen psykisk helse og rus. Arbeidet omfatter oppfølging av barn, unge og voksne, forebyggende arbeid, samarbeid med helsestasjon og skolehelsetjeneste, samt ledelse av kommunens psykososiale kriseteam (POSOM).

Stillingen er organisatorisk plassert under kommunalsjef for oppvekst og helse og har en bred samarbeidsflate. Du vil arbeide tett med øvrige helse- og omsorgstjenester i kommunen, samt med tjenester innen oppvekst.

Røyrvik kommune er en liten kommune med korte beslutningsveier og et nært samarbeid mellom tjenestene. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag, stor grad av selvstendighet og mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av framtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Oppfølging, kartlegging og veiledning av personer med psykiske helseutfordringer og/eller rusutfordringer.
  • Gjennomføring av støttesamtaler og mestringsorientert oppfølging.
  • Forebyggende og helsefremmende arbeid for barn, unge og voksne.
  • Oppgaver knyttet til skolehelsetjenesten og samarbeid med helsestasjonen.
  • Folkehelsekoordinator 
  • Lavterskeltilbud innen psykisk helse og rus.
  • Delta i fagutvikling og samarbeid med Grong, Namsskogan og Lierne.
  • Lede og koordinere kommunens psykososiale kriseteam (POSOM).
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent utdanning som sykepleier, gjerne med videreutdanning innen psykisk helsearbeid og/eller rusarbeid.
  • Vernepleier, sosionom eller annen relevant helse- og sosialfaglig høyskoleutdanning kan vurderes.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid innen psykisk helse og rus er ønskelig.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og førerkort klasse B.
  • Gyldig politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og evne til å skape tillit.
  • Selvstendig, strukturert og målrettet.
  • Gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner.
  • Fleksibel, løsningsorientert og utviklingsorientert.
Vi tilbyr
  • Spennende og meningsfull stilling med stor grad av selvstendighet.
  • Mulighet til å videreutvikle kommunens psykisk helse- og rustjenester.
  • Tett faglig samarbeid i Indre Namdal.
  • Videre utdanning innen psykisk helse og rus.
  • Kompetanseheving, lønn etter avtale og KLP-pensjon.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nasjonalparkkommunen Røyrvik byr på spennende kontraster med sine vidstrakte og naturskjønne omgivelser som gir mulighet til friluftsliv, jakt og fiske. Det er kort vei til lysløyper/alpinbakke i Børgefjellsenteret. Røyrvik kommune har et rikt kultur- og foreningsliv. Kommunen har et høyt servicenivå med gode skole- og barnehagetilbud og kan tilby trygge oppvekstsvilkår. Røyrvik kommune – kanskje ditt viktigste valg!

jobs.title: Barnehagemedarbeider
jobs.description:
Storgården barnehage søker barnehagemedarbeider.

Storgården barnehage ligger sentralt på Manglerud, med kort vei til kollektivtransport og flotte naturområder ved Østensjøvannet. Barnehagen består av 10 baser, flere temarom og et stort uteområde som gir gode muligheter for lek, utforsking og læring. Hos oss møter du et faglig engasjert arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger, stedlig styrer og konsulent.

Relasjonen mellom barn og voksne er et sentralt satsingsområde i bydelens barnehager. Vi legger vekt på å bygge trygge, stabile og omsorgsfulle relasjoner, da dette er avgjørende for barns trivsel, utvikling og læring. Barna skal møte voksne som gir omsorg, støtte og anerkjennelse, og som bidrar til et trygt og positivt læringsmiljø.

Vil du være med på å skape en trygg, spennende og meningsfull hverdag for barna? Da ønsker vi å høre fra deg!  

Arbeidsoppgaver

Delta aktivt i pedagogisk arbeid med enkelt barn og barnegruppen

Ta initiativ til aktiviteter sammen med barna

Legge til rette fot et godt foreldre samarbeid

Gjennomføre praktiske arbeidsoppgaver knyttet til basens og barnehagens drift

Bidra til et positivt leke og læringsmiljø

Være i aktivitet sammen med barna ute og inne

Bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø sammen med øvrige ansatte

 

Kvalifikasjoner

Gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig

Bestått norsk-prøve B1

Erfaring fra barnehage er en stor fordel

Erfaring fra Class

Beherske relevant datautstyr og systemer

Gyldig politiattest, ikke eldre enn tre måneder må fremvises før oppstart

Engasjement for barns utvikling, lek og læring

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Personlige egenskaper

Du må være engasjert, positiv og løsningsorientert

Fleksibel og tar del i ulike arbeidsoppgaver

Gode samarbeidsevner, med gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter

Du er ansvarsfull, lojal og jobber like godt i teams som selvstendig

Du er stabil og tydelig voksen som er god rollemodell for barna

Du brenner for barns utvikling

 

Vi tilbyr

Stedlig styrer

Nærmiljø med skog og mark, samt andre fasiliteter

Kort vei til kollektiv tilbud

En barnehage med høy faglig kompetanse

Godt arbeidsmiljø med humor i hverdagen

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår visjon: Bydel Østensjø – et godt sted å bo, hele livet! Bydel Østensjø er en frodig og grønn bydel sørøst i Oslo. Med Østensjøvannet naturreservat i midten og grense til Østmarka, gir bydelen mange muligheter for turer og friluftsliv, samtidig som veien til Oslo sentrum er kort. Innenfor bydelens ansvarsområder, skal bydelens 51 000 innbyggere tilbys fleksible tjenester i samsvar med sitt behov. Vi søker også å være en lærende organisasjon som alltid ser etter nye og smartere måter å jobbe på, med modige ledere som viser tillit til sine medarbeidere. Bli bedre kjent med bydelen her: www.bydel-ostensjo.oslo.kommune.no og www.facebook.com/bydelostensjo. Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

Interim ekonomichef inom digitalisering i Göteborg
jobs.description: Interim ekonomichef i Göteborg sökes för att leda ekonomistyrning och utveckla ekonomifunktionen inom digitalisering.Kombinera kvalificerat ekonomiledarskap med ett tydligt utvecklingsuppdrag. TNG söker en interim ekonomichef till en större offentlig organisation i Göteborg. Här får du säkerställa den löpande ekonomistyrningen, genomföra en översyn av ekonomifunktionen och ge strategiskt stöd till ledningen. Du arbetar nära verksamhetens chefer och tar fram konkreta förslag som stärker organisation, ansvarsfördelning och arbetssätt. Uppdraget passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet som ekonomichef eller CFO och vill använda den i en verksamhet med omfattande digitalisering.Ditt anställningserbjudandeDu får ett uppdrag där din erfarenhet kommer till användning i både det dagliga ekonomiarbetet och den långsiktiga utvecklingen. Med tillgång till verksamhetens ledning får du möjlighet att omsätta din analys i rekommendationer och en prioriterad åtgärdsplan. Uppdraget ger dig utrymme att kombinera ekonomistyrning, förändringsledning och organisationsutveckling, med fokus på hur ekonomifunktionen bäst kan stödja verksamhetens mål.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom interim ekonomichef ansvarar du för att upprätthålla kvalitet och stabilitet i ekonomistyrningen samtidigt som du analyserar ekonomifunktionens utvecklingsbehov. Du kommer att:    Säkerställa stabilitet, kvalitet och effektivitet i den löpande ekonomistyrningen.    Genomföra en strukturerad översyn av organisation, roller, ansvar, kompetensförsörjning, processer och arbetssätt.    Dokumentera nuläget och identifiera utvecklingsområden.    Ta fram förbättringsförslag och rekommendationer för framtida organisation och arbetssätt.    Utarbeta en prioriterad åtgärdsplan för ekonomifunktionens fortsatta utveckling.    Stödja ledningen och verksamhetens chefer i strategiska och ekonomiska frågor.    Löpande rapportera uppdragets resultat till ansvariga inom ekonomi och digitalisering.Värt att vetaDet här är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid under sex månader. Arbetet utförs på plats i Göteborg. Önskad start är den 16 november 2026 och du behöver kunna påbörja uppdraget snarast möjligt.Våra förväntningarVi söker dig som har minst tio års erfarenhet av kvalificerat ekonomistyrningsarbete och minst fem års erfarenhet som ekonomichef, CFO eller i en motsvarande ledande ekonomifunktion. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla ekonomifunktioner i större organisationer samt erfarenhet av budgetprocesser, prognosarbete, ekonomisk uppföljning och verksamhetsstyrning.Du har en akademisk examen inom ekonomi och aktuell erfarenhet av att genomföra översyn, förändring eller utveckling av ekonomifunktioner. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.Meriterande är erfarenhet som CFO i organisationer med fler än 500 anställda, motsvarande uppdrag i politiskt styrd verksamhet samt erfarenhet från digitalisering eller IT. Även förändringsledning, strategiska utvecklingsplaner och stöd till högsta ledningen i ekonomiska frågor är meriterande.Du har mycket god analytisk förmåga och sätter dig snabbt in i nya verksamheter och komplexa organisationer. Du kommunicerar tydligt och är van att presentera analyser, resultat och rekommendationer för ledningsgrupp och högre ledning.Intresserad?Detta är ett interimsuppdrag där du antingen kan bli anställd som konsult hos oss på TNG Interim eller blir anlitad som underkonsult för att arbeta på plats hos vår kund. TNG hjälper kandidater och konsulter att ta nästa steg i karriären, oavsett om de söker en ny tjänst eller vill kliva in i ett konsultuppdrag. Med en rättvis och datadriven metod, baserad på fakta och vetenskap, matchar vi dig med arbetsgivare som ser bortom ålder, titel och magkänsla och istället fokuserar på potential, rätt erfarenhet och nya perspektiv. Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn-profil och utan personligt brev. Notera att vi inte kan ta emot ansökningar via e-post, men att du alltid är välkommen att maila rekryteraren vid frågor. Efter inskickad ansökan kommer vi anonymisera dina personuppgifter och troligtvis be dig att genomföra vetenskapliga rekryteringstester och / eller en intervju med vår AI-avatar Tengai, innan vi gör en första bedömning. Givetvis får du mer information om varje steg när det är dags och så snart du skickat in din ansökan kan du följa den i realtid via vår hemsida. Observera att vi gör urval löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Varmt välkommen!

jobs.title: GM, Head of Data
jobs.description:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

GM, Head of Data

We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. This is a high-ownership role for an experienced business leader who has built or run a data business before and believes digital assets are where markets are heading.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the P&L for the data business, including revenue, costs, forecasting and performance reporting to executive leadership.

  • Set and execute product strategy: decide where to invest, what to scale and what to sunset, based on product traction and market demand.

  • Build a commercial model that serves both self-service customers and enterprise clients, including packaging, pricing and distribution.

  • Lead the research, product and data science teams, making sure research drives product development and supports Talos more broadly.

  • Partner with sales, marketing and engineering, which sit outside your reporting line, to align priorities and deliver revenue growth.

  • Own client outcomes and account health, resolving issues and driving retention and expansion.

  • Define the positioning and brand strategy for the data business within the wider Talos group.

  • Build a high-performing, motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and shared identity.

 

Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading a business unit or owning a P&L, ideally at a market data, index or financial data provider.

  • A track record of turning around or growing a business, with clear, measurable results.

  • Strong data product expertise, including monetisation, packaging, pricing and go-to-market for both self-service and enterprise models.

  • A background in capital markets. Digital assets experience is a plus, but a strong understanding of and conviction about the asset class is essential.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver through cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Experience building and leading research, product or data science teams.

  • Sound commercial judgement and accurate forecasting.

  • Executive presence and the ability to engage and constructively challenge senior leadership.

  • A builder’s mindset, suited to fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments rather than established incumbents.

jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers.

What you will do

  • Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses.

  • Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition.

  • Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer.

  • Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition.

  • Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface.

  • Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery.

  • Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer.

  • Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool.

Your profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field.

  • ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation.

  • Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux.

  • Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ).

  • Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware.

  • Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks.

  • Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition.

  • Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering.

  • High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development.

  • Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data.

  • Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment.

  • Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

  • A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

  • Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

  • A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

  • Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.

  • Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.

  • Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.

  • Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

Required qualifications

  • BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.

  • Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.

  • Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.

  • A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.

  • As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English

  • Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.

  • Previous experience working in cancer biology

  • Fluent in English

Recruitment process

  • HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  • Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  • Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.

  • Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Air
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Lead Engineer, Air to take hands-on technical ownership of our first Western-facing air product, turning operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

Your initial focus will be one product. You’ll bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams together around a controlled design and a clear delivery plan, resolving the reliability and integration challenges that stand between today’s product and repeatable production.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, own system-level engineering decisions and ensure that changes are proven through testing and reflected in what we build.

As our air portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Air. Progression will depend on business need and demonstrated performance, rather than a fixed promotion timetable.

What you’ll do

  • Establish product ownership and a delivery plan. In your first 30 days, assess the current design, customer requirements and test evidence with engineering, manufacturing and field teams. Identify the highest-priority risks and agree a 90-day plan with clear owners, milestones and acceptance criteria.

  • Create a controlled technical baseline. By day 60, establish practical requirements, configuration records, bills of materials, interface definitions and change control so teams know what has been approved, built, tested and deployed.

  • Lead end-to-end systems integration. Own technical trade-offs across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces and ground systems, drawing on specialist expertise where needed.

  • Improve reliability and demonstrate performance. During the initial three to five months, establish a failure-reporting and corrective-action process, address priority failure modes and verify improvements through repeatable ground and flight testing against agreed requirements.

  • Prepare the product for repeatable production. Partner with manufacturing and supply chain on design for manufacture, component qualification, approved substitutions and supplier risks. Release a production package covering drawings, BOM, assembly requirements, inspection and acceptance tests, supported by a costed BOM and cost-reduction priorities.

  • Enable credible customer trials and delivery. Define approved configurations, test plans and readiness criteria. Validate capability claims, document operating limits and provide clear engineering input on delivery feasibility, support needs and technical risks.

  • Connect operational experience to product development. Work closely with Ukrainian product experts and international teams to preserve field knowledge, manage configuration differences and translate operator and customer feedback into prioritised product changes.

  • Build a foundation for portfolio growth. Identify reusable architecture, components and engineering practices, recommend capability and resource needs, and review the scope for broader ownership with leadership as the portfolio develops.

Required Skill

  • Hands-on UAS engineering ownership: Experience leading delivery of a complete air vehicle or substantial integrated UAS product, with clear evidence of your own technical decisions and their impact on flight performance.

  • Systems integration judgement: The ability to reason across mechanical, electrical, flight-control, communications, navigation and software interfaces, and recognise when specialist depth is needed.

  • Prototype-to-production experience: Meaningful involvement in taking an aerial product into repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production testing.

  • Reliability and test discipline: A track record of diagnosing flight or field failures, identifying root causes and proving corrective actions through repeatable testing.

  • Cross-functional technical leadership: The ability to set priorities, coordinate engineers and specialist partners, and drive delivery through influence as well as formal authority.

  • Cost and component judgement: Practical understanding of how design decisions affect availability, qualification, unit cost, manufacturing quality and applicable sourcing requirements.

  • Operational awareness: Understanding of how GNSS denial, jamming, communications resilience and operator feedback influence UAS design and testing.

  • Startup execution: Comfort working close to hardware, making decisions with incomplete information and balancing delivery speed with appropriate engineering control.

  • Clear communication and ownership: The ability to distinguish demonstrated capability from development goals, explain limitations and escalate technical, safety or resource risks early.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian UAS teams, products or operators.

  • Experience adapting products for Western defence customers.

  • Familiarity with applicable NDAA, Blue UAS and export-control requirements.

  • Experience supporting customer trials, military qualification or airworthiness activity.

  • Experience with payload integration or payload-release systems.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across countries.

  • Evidence of growing from hands-on product ownership into broader technical leadership.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

  • Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

  • Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

  • Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

  • A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineering – Platform & Build
jobs.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

As an Infrastructure Platform Engineer you will be a core part of our technical team working alongside the hardware, software and research teams to solve cutting-edge problems in AI hardware, ranging from verification to simulation, alongside the best of the best (DeepMind, Apple, Meta…).

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Infrastructure sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

The Infrastructure team is responsible for the core platform and systems at Fractile. We build, scale, and optimize the mission-critical systems that power our entire engineering org, including our multi-language Bazel monorepo and CI pipelines. From hardware design and verification to kernel development and ML compilers, we enable all Fractile engineers to ship fast and reliably.

The team brings both deep build system expertise and an SRE mindset: reliability, build performance, debugging CI failures systematically, and giving the engineering organisation clear visibility into how our infrastructure is performing.

As an Infrastructure Platform Engineer, you will:

  • Own the CI infrastructure end-to-end: create, maintain and debug reproducible multi-language CI pipelines, and optimize CI performance across large compute clusters.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure observability, alerting, runbooks, and incident response workflows for Fractile's infrastructure.

  • Own our infrastructure as code, automating provisioning of hybrid cloud and on-prem resources from a single source of truth.

  • Scale and maintain Fractile's Bazel monorepo as we continue growing across Python, C++, Rust, SystemVerilog, and ML workloads.

  • Shape the infrastructure and platform experience for every engineer at Fractile.

About you

You bring deep infrastructure and build systems expertise alongside an SRE mindset. You are systematic in how you approach fault isolation and root cause analysis, and you apply metrics-driven thinking to build reliability and developer productivity. You thrive on variety (ML, compilers, kernel drivers, simulators, hardware verification) and you understand that your work becomes the foundation every engineer at Fractile builds on. You take that responsibility seriously.

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering

  • 5+ years hands-on experience working with CI/CD for large-scale products, including monitoring, debugging performance and resolving pipeline failures at scale

  • 3+ years working with build systems, preferably modern cross-language build systems with an emphasis on correctness, high performance and extensibility, such as Bazel, Buck, Pants, Please, etc.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform / OpenTofu, or Pulumi)

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)

  • Working knowledge and practice of DevOps / SRE principles: SLOs, alerting design, incident management, and on-call practice

  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems or scripting language used for tooling (Python preferred; Go or Rust also relevant), with a track record of shipping well-tested, maintainable developer tooling that other engineers rely on: CLIs, CI integrations, build and release automation

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.
