jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

Find out more here.

What we pay

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/aie

***

THE KEY BITS

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £115,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. What you’ve done in the last ~2 years is far more important to us than how long you’ve been an engineer — so if you think you meet the requirements but are worried you’re not “senior” enough, we strongly encourage you to still apply. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in your application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Pavel Nekrasov, Director of Engineering and lead of the Agentic team at Juro

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Our Agentic team was the first team at Juro to go fully AI-native, and it's been the role model for our other product teams as Juro evolved into an AI company.

As the Agentic team, we build the AI foundations the rest of engineering ships on — starting with Operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro.

We want Operator to do a lot more. That takes more and better tools, solid evals, and a harness that keeps up with a stack that’s still rapidly evolving. And more great people to do it.

What you're here to do

Give Operator the tools it needs to act across Juro and make sure what it does is measurably good. In your first months, success looks like this:

  • You've shipped new tools that connect Operator to the Juro app, from first idea to production.

  • What you ship has evals around it, supported by the Quality Assurance team, so we can tell whether a new model, prompt or library version makes things better or worse.

  • You own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) without the team becoming a. bottleneck.

  • You review a lot of agent-written code and decide quickly what's safe to merge and what will break three cycles later.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core Principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You’re a programmer first, and you now build with AI and LLMs. You’ve written production TypeScript/Node.js and MongoDB for users. Agents write most of the code today, but you can still tell when an agent’s output shouldn’t go through.

  • You’ve built agentic systems yourself, including the tools that let agents act on APIs and integrations. You can explain the parts of an agent (planning, tools, context, the loop around them) because you’ve built them.

  • You’ve written and run evals and think about quality in probabilities.

  • You’ve shipped something people can use: a product, an open-source project or a tool. (We’ll ask you for a link or description in our application form.)

  • Bonus: you’ve used our AI stack before. It changes often, so understanding why things break matters more than knowing the tools already.

Day to day, you’ll work with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis and pgvector on AWS, plus Bedrock, LiteLLM and Mastra for the AI layer.

These requirements can come from a job, a side project or open source. The field is about two years old, so we care about what you've built, not how many years you've been doing it.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need a polished setup before you can ship. We'd rather ship a small, good version this week than a perfect one in two weeks, by which time the stack has moved on.

  • You want a stable roadmap. Priorities here can change week to week.

  • You want to rebuild things whenever you'd have done them differently. We disagree a lot and openly, but once a call is made, we commit and move.

  • You've only ever worked inside one opinionated framework and never looked under the hood.

  • You'd rather build product UI. Most of this work is foundations other engineers build on.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach ----- for anything.

Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe.

À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes :

  • Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe.

  • Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche).

  • Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP.

  • Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.).

  • Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe.

2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel

  • Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation.

  • Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis.

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design).

3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act)

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design).

  • Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables.

4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation

  • Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.).

  • Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires.

Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

  • Design and govern the full IT-service lifecycle, from requirements through deployment, operations, and decommissioning. 

  • Architect solutions spanning cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

  • Lead and mentor internal and external architects and technical teams across complex programs. 

  • Apply TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL practices to structure architecture governance and IT service management processes. 

  • Represent TYTAN's technical architecture to customers, partners, and integrators. 


  • Defense-sector experience is mandatory; a former military background is strongly preferred. 

  • Practical, hands-on experience with Sparx Enterprise Architect, NAF v4 and/or ADMBw. 

  • Strong IT, software, or systems architecture background. 

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in solution architecture or technical IT consulting. 

  • Experience with TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL; relevant certifications preferred. 

  • Experience designing complex IT service-management platforms and processes. 

  • Experience with cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead internal and external architects and technical teams. 

  • Fluent German and English. 

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

jobs.title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) AI-Startup
jobs.description:
Du kannst gut verkaufen? Dann könnten wir gut Matchen.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales auf selbstständiger Basis, zunächst ideal als Nebenjob. Du hast die Chance, früh in ein internationales AI-Startup einzusteigen, ein Vertriebsteam aufzubauen und dies für den gesamten deutschen Markt zu leiten. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt ist auf Wunsch ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag + Fixgehalt vorgesehen.

Über uns

Wir sind ein Startup und arbeiten überwiegend remote. Optional kannst du auch vor Ort aus Hamburg, London oder Prag mit uns arbeiten.

Aktuell bauen wir Fenie auf, eine innovative KI-Assistentin speziell für Kosmetikstudios und Unternehmen aus der Beauty-Branche. Fenie hilft die Beauty Branche dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation zu automatisieren.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sale (m/w/d), der Vertrieb im Blut hat und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Vergütung & Perspektive

Aktuell bieten wir kein fixes Grundgehalt, da wir uns noch in der Growth-Phase befinden. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt daher auf selbstständiger Basis, (siehe unten unter „Vergütung“).

Damit bietet gleichzeitig bewusst einige Vorteile für diejenigen, die an unserem Wachstum partizipieren möchten.

Du kannst ein eigenes Vertriebsteam aufbauen und zusätzlich an dessen Provisionen mitverdienen. Dazu kommen deine eigene Provision sowie wiederkehrende Provisionen, die deutlich höher ausfallen als bei vergleichbaren Jobangeboten.

Bei unserem zweiten Startup verdienen unsere Kollegen, die Head of Sales Mitarbeiter aktuell zwischen 6.000 und 7.000 € im Monat, ein realistischer Einblick dafür, was nach einer kurzen Zeit möglich ist.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Vertrieb

  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundenakquise, insbesondere Telefonakquise und Cold Calling

  • Du hast bereits nachweislich Erfahrung darin, potenzielle Kunden aktiv anzusprechen und für ein Produkt oder eine Dienstleistung zu gewinnen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Einwandbehandlung und Follow-ups

  • Im besten Fall Erfahrungen in der Beauty und Software Bernache

  • Absolut Zuverlässigkeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst Kosmetik, Beauty- und ähnliche Studios telefonisch durch Cold Calling. Eine freundliche und meist lockere Zielgruppe.

  • Leads stellen wir zu Verfügung

  • Du stellst Fenie potenziellen Kunden vor

  • Du erklärst einfach und verständlich, welchen Mehrwert KI im Alltag bietet

  • Du baust auf Wunsch ein Team auf uns leitest dies

  • Du arbeitest neue Vertriebsmitarbeiter ein

Was dich bei Fenie erwartet

  • Ein schnell wachsendes AI-Startup

  • 100 % Remote, innerhalb Europa

  • Die Möglichkeit, das gesamtes Vertriebsteam für den deutschen Markt zu leiten

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung innerhalb unserer Vertriebszeiten zwischen 9 und 17 Uhr

  • Hohes Provisionsmodell durch hohe Margen im Softwaregeschäft

  • Wiederkehrende hohe Provisionen sind Standard

  • Einstieg in einer frühen Startup-Phase

Vergütung

· 50 % Provision auf Erstzahlungen

· 20 % Provision auf monatlich wiederkehrende Zahlungen (unsere AI verkaufen wir ausschließlich im Abo Modelle und mit Jahresplänen)

· 10 % Provision auf Umsätze deines Vertriebsteams, was du führen kannst - deutschlandweit

Schreib uns einfach kurz, wer du bist, welche Vertriebserfahrung du mitbringst und warum du Lust darauf hast, Fenie gemeinsam mit uns aufzubauen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Dein Fenie Team

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de recrutement (H/F)
jobs.description: Chargé(e) de recrutement F/H - Luxembourg - Intérim et recrutement Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre métier en rejoignant un groupe familial leader européen du recrutement, du développement des compétences et des services RH.Pour renforcer notre équipe au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) chargé(e) de recrutement.Vous serez en charge du recrutement de personnel ouvrier pour l'une de nos agences. Votre rôle au quotidien : En lien direct avec le responsable d'agence, vous prenez part à chaque étape du recrutement et au suivi des missions d'intérim. Comprendre les besoins des entreprises clientes et définir les profils à rechercherRédiger des offres ciblées et identifier les talents grâce aux CVthèques, aux réseaux professionnels et aux candidatures reçuesAccueillir les candidats, conduire les entretiens, apprécier leurs compétences et motivations en adéquation avec les postesPrésenter les candidatures pertinentes, coordonner les échanges avec les clients et accompagner la prise de posteEntretenir une relation de proximité avec les clients et les intérimaires, et suivre le bon déroulement des missionsGérer les dossiers du personnel (contrats, relevés d'heures.) dans le respect des procédures et de la réglementation applicable Les atouts pour réussir :  Une formation en ressources humaines, commerce ou dans un domaine connexe, ainsi qu'une premier/ière expérience en recrutement, idéalement en agence d'intérim ou en cabinetUne bonne pratique des entretiens, des outils de recherche de candidats et des outils bureautiquesLe français courant, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atoutUne écoute attentive, le sens du service et l'envie de créer des relations durablesDe la rigueur, de la réactivité, du dynamisme et un esprit d'équipe pour gérer les priorités dans un quotidien rythmé Pourquoi nous rejoindre Rejoindre notre agence, c'est associer la proximité d'une équipe locale à la dimension d'un groupe familial européen. Vous exercez un métier concret et varié, au contact des candidats et des entreprises, et contribuez chaque jour à la réussite de leurs projets. Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre parcours et d'échanger avec vous.Votre candidature sera étudiée avec attention et en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Agent de prévention et proximité (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Agent de prévention et proximité (m/f)Acteur majeur du logement abordable au Luxembourg, le Fonds du Logement développe des projets qui contribuent concrètement à améliorer la qualité de vie des citoyens et à répondre aux défis du logement.   En rejoignant nos équipes, vous contribuez à la conservation du patrimoine immobilier du Fonds du logement en effectuant l'ensemble des tâches opérationnelles et en étant la premier/ière personne de contact des locataires.Votre rôle au sein de l'équipe :Organiser et surveiller les travaux d'entretien de notre patrimoineSurveiller l'aspect général de l'immeuble et ses alentours (espaces verts, aires de jeu, parkings etc.) Assurer des travaux de petite envergure (serrurerie, sanitaire, électricité, menuiserie .)Assurer un suivi des fournisseurs et sous-traitants et la bonne exécution des travauxRéceptionner et transmettre les réclamations de nos clients locatairesEffectuer les visites des logements avec les candidats locatairesAssurer un suivi administratif des interventions, travaux, relevés de compteurs etcTenir à jour le registre de sécurité des immeubles dont vous avez la chargeSuivre l'évolution des différents systèmes HVAC, techniques diverses pour les bâtiments et de sécuritéParticiper à la rotation de permanences (soirs et weekends)Votre profil :Formation de niveau CATP d'un métier artisanalPremier/ière expérience en tant qu'ouvrier technique ou artisan polyvalent souhaitéeConnaissance des critères de salubrité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et d'habitabilité des logements Connaissances dans les domaines de la sécurité et  au travail, d'une gestion technique centraliséeVos atouts pour réussir :Connaissance des outils informatiques courants (MS Office) Sens de l'organisation et rigueurAisance relationnelle et contact aiséBonne connaissance d'au moins deux des trois langues du pays (luxembourgeois, français et/ou allemand). Toute autre langue constituant un avantagePermis de conduire de catégorie BPourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un métier porteur de sens : Au Fonds du Logement, chaque mission a un impact concret : accueillir, loger et accompagner. Nos  collaborateurs contribuent activement au développement du logement abordable au Luxembourg et à l'accompagnement des ménages.Un établissement tourné vers l'avenir, portant desprojets innovants et d'envergure inscrits dans une démarche durable et circulaire.Une culture portée par des valeurs fortes : le respect, la collaboration, l'engagement, l'éthique et la qualité.Un environnement de travail stable et attractif, favorisant le bien-être de nos collaborateurs et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.À ce titre, nous vous proposons :Un contrat stable au sein d'un établissement public reconnuUne rémunération attractive tenant compte de votre expérience et de votre niveau de responsabilitéUne allocation de famille, sous réserve d'éligibilitéUne augmentation salariale annuelle garantieUne carte dédynamiquer Pluxee Lunch jours de congés annuelsDes horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité de télétravaillerDes opportunités de développement professionnel : mobilité interne, budget individuel de formation, cours de langues.Des infrastructures modernes et facilement accessiblesDes évènements internes organisés par notre Fun Team tout au long de l'année (afterwork, teambuilding, visites culturelles et de patrimoine, activités sportives, etc.) Notre processus de recrutement :Nous accordons une attention particulier/ière à la qualité et à la transparence de notre processus de recrutement. Les étapes :Réception de votre candidature avant le  octobre Analyse et présélection des candidaturesEntretien avec votre futur manager et un membre des Ressources HumainesValidation finale de votre engagement par notre COMEXEn cas d'entretien d'embauche, un extrait de  vous sera demandé conformément aux exigences liées à la fonction.Signataires de la Charte de la Diversité Lëtzebuerg, nous nous engageons à promouvoir l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Customer Support Assistant - Digital Services (M/F) (H/F)
jobs.description: Fondée en , la Banque Internationale à Luxembourg (BIL) est la plus ancien/ienne banque universelle du Grand-Duché. Depuis sa création, elle joue un rôle actif dans les principales phases du développement de l'économie luxembourgeoise. Elle exerce aujourd'hui les métiers de banque de détail, banque privée et banque des entreprises et participe aux marchés de capitaux. Avec plus de 2. collaborateurs, la Banque est présente au Luxembourg, en Suisse et en Chine. Acteur majeur de la place financier/ière luxembourgeoise et signataire des « Principles for Responsible Banking » de l'UNEP FI (United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative), la BIL s'engage pour la construction d'une économie durable. Votre mission : Vous serez responsable de la prise en charge des demandes clients reçues via les différents canaux de communication.Vos responsabilités : Vous accompagnez les clients lors de l'Onboarding Digital. Vous maîtrisez et promouvez activement les solutions de self-service, et accompagnez les clients dans l'utilisation de BILnet et LuxTrust. Vous répondez aux appels des clients, identifiez leurs besoins, traitez leurs objections et transformez chaque contact en opportunité. Vous traitez les messages sécurisés envoyés par les clients et intervenez de manier/ière proactive lorsque nécessaire. Vous mettez en place et à jour les contrats Multiline, Ebics et E-reporting. Vous documentez chaque appel afin d'alimenter la base de données. Vous orientez les clients, internes ou externes, vers le département approprié lorsque la résolution immédiate n'est pas possible, et vous signalez les problèmes récurrents afin d'identifier des solutions durables. Vous prenez les rendez-vous clients pour les gestionnaires de clientèle. Vos compétences : Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 ou expérience équivalente.Esprit d'équipe développé.Excellentes capacités relationnelles, de communication et d'écoute.Solides compétences informatiques et digitales.Bonne capacité d'analyse et forte orientation solution.Capacité à identifier et à transformer les opportunités commerciales.Autonomie, sens de la persuasion et excellente organisation.Maîtrise des outils BILnet, Salesforce, T et MS Office.Bonne connaissance des produits distribués au sein de la Banque.Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois et de toute autre langue constitue un avantage. La BIL offre une large gamme de projets stimulants et un important choix de carrier/ières. Nous vous aiderons à trouver la voie qui répond le plus à vos compétences et à vos attentes. Votre développement personnel est notre priorité et nous vous encourageons à vous impliquer le plus possible pour que votre expérience soit la meilleure. La BIL est convaincue que la diversité et l'inclusion contribuent à accroître la performance collective de la Banque. Nous nous engageons à créer une culture inclusive qui encourage le développement individuel de nos employés. NB : le candidat retenu devra délivrer un extrait de  (bulletin n°3); datant de moins de 3 mois, afin de garantir son honorabilité au poste visé compte tenu de la confidentialité des informations à observer dans l'exercice de sa fonction. jobs.title: DEEP - Cloud Architect OVH / Clever Cloud / Cloud Native (H/F)
jobs.description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Architect OVH / Clever Cloud / Cloud Native (m/f/n) à temps plein. Le poste a pour objectif de concevoir, cadrer et faire évoluer des architectures et services cloud modernes pour nos clients, avec une orientation forte vers les environnements cloud public OVH, Clever Cloud, les architectures cloud native et notre cloud souverain OVH OPCP (On-Prem Cloud Platform).Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Maîtriser le français et l'anglais, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.

jobs.title: Extra åpner ny butikk i Hammerfest - er du vår nye butikksjef?
jobs.employer: COOP HAMMERFEST SA AVD 026 COOP PRIX HAMMERFEST
jobs.description:
Vil du være med fra starten og sette ditt preg på en helt ny Extra-butikk i Hammerfest?

I mars 2027 åpner vi Hammerfest sin nye dagligvarebutikk. Butikken blir en moderne butikk på 1000 kvm salgsflate med åpninstider fra 7-23. 

Vi ønsker oss en inspirerende og engasjert leder med relevant erfaring fra dagligvare eller varehandel. Vi håper og tror du legger stor vekt på god kundeservice, da gode kundemøter er noe av det vi ser som aller viktigst :-). Som butikksjef har du totalansvar for driften og jobber sammen med de ansatte for å beholde vårt gode arbeidsmiljø. 

Kunne du tenke deg å drive Finnmarks nyeste EXTRA butikk? Da kan dette være perfekt for deg!

Søknadsfrist: 24.10.2026 Oppstart 01.02.27

Hva kan du få hos oss?Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ledere og har også et støtteapparat som bistår våre ledere. Derfor kan vi si at vi legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs som butikksjef hos oss. Stillingen har mulighet for bonus, skaper du gode resultater får du igjen for det. I tillegg til lønn etter avtale selvsagt. Vi har telefonordning, ansattrabatter og pensjonsordning. Ikke minst får du en gjeng med utrolig engasjerte og skikkelig gode kollegaer:-). Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg.

Hva skal du gjøre?Som butikksjef har du det overordnede ansvaret for drift, resultater og personal, og vil være en synlig og motiverende leder i hverdagen. Resultater skaper du gjennom en positiv væremåte, grundig arbeid og god ledelse både i butikken og i møte med kundene. Oppgaver som rekruttering, opplæring, oppfølging og utvikling følger naturlig med stillingen. Sist men ikke minst, så er det viktig at du skaper et godt miljø og en hyggelig butikk for våre kunder å besøke, gjennom å inspirere og motivere de som jobber sammen med deg.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har erfaring som assisterende butikksjef eller butikksjef.
  • Det er viktig at du motiverer og skaper engasjement og trivsel med dine medarbeidere.
  • Du er genuint opptatt av kundeservice og bidrar til å skape gode resultater på våre løpende kundemålinger.
  • Det er ønskelig at du har relevant ledererfaring innen varehandel, gjerne dagligvarebransjen.
  • Følger kjedens konsept
  • Det å skape gode økonomiske resultater motiverer deg.

 

Spørsmål til stillingen kan rettes til personalsjef Ida Ostad på telefon: 482 03 701.

 

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da er du kanskje den nye lederen vi ser etter:-)

Coop Hammerfest SA er et medlemseid samvirkeforetak med drøyt 5700 medeiere. Selskapet har 4 butikker i Hammerfest Kommune. Vi har i dag 3 Extra og 1 Prix Butikk. Vi er ca. 75 ansatte, og forventet omsetning i 2027 er om lag 320 millioner. Vi er ett samvirkerlag i sterk vekst og ønsker deg gjerne med !

jobs.title: Data Scientist
Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

 

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

 

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

 

The role

We're looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) to join our engineering team. This is an engineering-first role: FDSEs are the technical owners who take the Encord platform into our most strategic and advanced customer environments, working directly with users and their engineering teams to understand complex problems, make system design decisions, and build production software that solves them.


As an early member of the Forward Deployed team, you'll have an outsized impact on shaping a critical engineering function at Encord. You'll work hands-on across the stack, from APIs and data workflows to backend services and product surfaces, while owning technical problems end to end. You'll make architecture decisions under real production constraints, debug complex integrations and workflows, and build solutions that can scale beyond a single customer or use case. You'll operate autonomously, defining the right technical approach with limited guidance, building trusted relationships with users, and feeding what you learn directly back into the product and engineering roadmap.

 

What you'll do

  • Design and build production software for complex data, ML, and application environments

  • Own system design decisions for deployments, balancing correctness, scalability, performance, and speed

  • Work directly with customers and their engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems and define the right technical solution

  • Build across the stack, from APIs and data workflows to backend systems and product-facing functionality

  • Own deployments from technical scoping through implementation, rollout, and iteration

  • Turn recurring customer problems into reusable tooling and product capabilities

  • Debug complex production issues across reliability, performance, and data flow

  • Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Operate with high autonomy and own problems end to end

  • Feed deployment insights back into Product and Engineering, and help shape the FDSE function as the team grows

     

Who we're looking for

  • A strong software engineer. You have solid fundamentals and the technical depth to design and build complex production systems

  • A first-principles problem solver. You dig into the underlying problem, challenge assumptions, and make sound technical and product trade-offs rather than defaulting to the obvious solution

  • A strong communicator and stakeholder partner. You can build trust, navigate competing priorities, and explain complex decisions clearly

  • An autonomous builder. You operate with limited guidance, create structure from ambiguity, and drive problems through to production

  • A versatile product engineer. You’re comfortable working across the stack and moving between hands-on engineering, product thinking, and conversations with the people using what you build

     

Experience requirements

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience with strong CS fundamentals

  • Experience building production software across the stack, from product-facing applications and APIs to backend services and data workflows

  • Strong system design judgment and experience making architecture decisions for complex software

  • Strong coding skills in a modern language; Python is a plus

  • Evidence of owning technical problems end to end, from design through production

  • Strong product judgment, technical communication, and stakeholder management

  • Experience working directly with users, customers, or external engineering teams is a plus

  • Bonus: experience in a high-growth startup, developer platform, or ML/data product environment

     

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

 

Operating principles

 

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

jobs.description:
Role Details

Level: Senior/ Lead

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

Weekly hours: 3-4 days/ week

Location: Remote Europe, GMT/BST or CET friendly

Language: English, plus Spanish and/or Portuguese

 

In this role, you’ll be a senior technical advisor to city governments across North, Central and South America, working in both an advisory and a hands-on capacity to help them design, build and launch small scale pilots of new services for residents.

Working alongside experienced product managers, data scientists, AI engineers, and designers, you’ll help multidisciplinary city teams build in-house product development capability by prototyping and delivering digital products and services, many of which harness data and AI.

You won’t own the decisions, but you’ll shape them. You’ll guide cities through the full product development lifecycle, helping them weigh the strategic and technical trade-offs at each stage: how to design system and data architecture that’s right-sized for a pilot but built to scale, how to prototype and test possible solutions to validate assumptions, and when AI approaches such as machine learning or large language models are the right tool (and when they aren’t). You’ll roll up your sleeves to prototype and demonstrate what good looks like, while making sure your clients understand the reasoning well enough to own the outcome.

This role suits someone with the technical depth of a tech lead, and the judgement, communication skills and patience to lead through influence rather than authority. You’ll need to work fluently in English and in at least one of Spanish or Portuguese.

 

Key skills and experiences

  • Extensive hands-on technical experience, with strong knowledge of system and data architecture, data pipelines, DevOps and infrastructure, and a track record of delivering and deploying robust solutions end to end, from prototype to pilot, across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments, including legacy systems and resource-constrained ones, so that your recommendations are realistic and buildable.

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning approaches, including large language models, and experience deploying them or working alongside ML engineers to integrate them into products, with enough understanding to judge when they’re the right tool and how to build them in responsibly.

  • Experience taking products from early concept to first release, while laying foundations for scale, with a track record of rapid prototyping and assumption testing and a “show, don’t tell” approach that uses working prototypes to build shared understanding and inform decisions.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating closely with product managers, designers and other disciplines throughout the product lifecycle.

  • The ability to explain technical ideas and trade-offs clearly to audiences of all technical levels, from engineers to non-technical stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

  • Experience setting technical direction for a project or small team and guiding other engineers, as a tech lead or senior engineer.

  • Experience influencing technical decisions you don't directly control, whether in a consulting or advisory role or as an in-house engineer working across teams and with senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity and flexibility in problem solving, and comfort working through ambiguity and uncertainty in complex environments.

  • Professional working proficiency in English and in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with multicultural teams and on international projects.

  • Experience working with government or other public-sector organisations, or on services for residents and citizens.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, such as data privacy, bias and fairness, transparency, and the governance considerations specific to public-sector use of AI.

  • Experience supporting organisations to build their own technical capability, for example through coaching, mentoring or setting up new teams and practices.

Our hiring process

We’ve kept the process short and focused. Here’s what to expect:

1. Application & Video
As part of your application, we’ll ask you to record a short video (1–3 minutes, instructions below) describing a technical project — work or personal — that you really enjoyed working on.

  • Please record it in Spanish or Portuguese, whichever you speak fluently.

  • You don’t need to show your face — a voiceover on a screen share, or any other format you’re comfortable with, is fine.

  • We want to understand what the project was and why you enjoyed working on it. This isn’t a test of production quality; we’re interested in how you think and talk about your work.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.


How to record and submit your video

The simplest way is Loom (free, no download needed):

  1. Go to loom.com and create a free account.

  2. Click New video → Record a video in your browser. Choose Screen and camera or Screen only if you’d prefer not to appear on camera, and make sure your microphone is selected.

  3. Record your video — remember, 1 to 3 minutes is all we need. The free plan has a 5-minute limit, which is plenty.

  4. When you stop recording, Loom will open the video and give you a link. Click Copy link.

  5. Check the sharing setting is Anyone with the link can view.

  6. Paste the link into the Link to your video field on the application form.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Product Manager

The Role

Lyrebird is already trusted by thousands of clinicians, and the largest health organisations in Australia and the UK are now rolling it out across their entire workforce. This is a new role, created to lead the next chapter of our enterprise product as those deployments grow in size and ambition. You'll own the enterprise product end to end: the core platform capability that serves every enterprise customer, and the tailored work that deepens our partnership with specific ones. You'll have a real roadmap, a real engineering team, and the scope to shape where enterprise goes next.

A good week in this role might include a roadmap session with a state health service's IT team, a deep dive with a private hospital group to understand what's behind their latest request and how it could become something every enterprise customer benefits from, and a morning with engineering working out which of three competing priorities goes first. Your customers are the people deploying Lyrebird across their organisation, not the clinicians themselves, so you'll spend more time in customer conversations than most PMs do. If you enjoy that mix, and like being the person who makes the call when everything seems urgent, you'll do well here.

About Us

We turn real clinical conversations into accurate notes, automatically, backed by ambient real time document creation, intelligent document management and clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a patient and clinical communications layer. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We're growing fast across Melbourne, the UK, and Asia, and there's a finite window right now to set the standard for clinical AI in Australia before anyone else does.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise product, extending how Lyrebird serves hospitals, health services and multi-site groups: org hierarchy, SSO and provisioning, admin tooling, template governance, audit and usage reporting

  • Shape the enterprise roadmap, sequencing the platform capability that unlocks our next wave of large-scale deployments, and use it as a tool to communicate direction to customers, setting clear expectations about what's coming and when.

  • Build and own the prioritisation framework for enterprise, with clear, written criteria for core and tailored work that the whole business can rely on

  • Bring several independent streams of enterprise requests into one set of priorities, so every request has a clear home, a priority and a rationale anyone can explain

  • Turn tailored customer requests into buildable solutions, and spot the ones that are really core product needs wearing a customer's name

  • Stand up the voice-of-customer loop, spending real time with senior customer stakeholders and making sure what they tell you shapes what gets built

  • Drive roadmap decisions from usage and adoption data, working hand in hand with our UK team so every market benefits from what we learn

  • Deliver customer-specific integrations and workflows for some of the largest health organisations in the country, coordinating across engineering teams you don't own

What you'll bring

  • Experience owning a B2B or enterprise product end to end, shipped for large, complex organisations with their own governance, stakeholders and procurement

  • A track record of handling bespoke customer work without refusing it outright or letting it consume the roadmap, and the real examples to show how you made those calls

  • A habit of prioritising with written, defensible criteria, and the ability to walk through the trade-offs behind decisions you've made

  • Credibility in the room with senior enterprise customers: presenting and defending a roadmap to an executive or IT lead, and knowing when to hold the line and when to change course

  • The technical fluency to work credibly with engineers on architecture, integration and feasibility, and to land dependencies with teams that have their own roadmaps

Nice to have

  • Experience in health tech, clinical software or another regulated domain, including familiarity with EMRs and Australian health system structures such as LHDs, HHSs and private hospital groups

  • Hands-on experience building enterprise platform capability (SSO, provisioning, permissions, audit) or integration depth with HL7, FHIR and identity

  • An understanding of what hospital security, privacy and information-governance reviews demand of a vendor

  • Experience working across two markets with different regulatory requirements, or standing up a voice-of-customer loop from scratch

When a hospital rolls Lyrebird out to every clinician on every ward, the product has to work for the organisation as well as for the doctor in the room. The enterprise product is how thousands more clinicians spend their time on patients instead of paperwork, in the places where the pressure, and the risk of something being missed, is highest. That's the work.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)

  • Référence : 261828S

  • Démarrage : Immédiat

  • Durée : Long Terme - Mission de 12 mois, avec intégration en CDI client ensuite

  • Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC

  • Zone géographique : Île-de-France (78)

  • Déplacements possibles : Oui, déplacements réguliers en Normandie et dans les Hauts-de-France

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un projet majeur du secteur nucléaire, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication spécialisé en chaudronnerie nucléaire pour accompagner la structuration, la mise en place et le pilotage d'activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés, notamment en acier inoxydable.

La mission s'articule autour de deux sites de fabrication présentant des niveaux de maturité différents : le premier dispose déjà d'une expertise et d'une expérience confirmées en fabrication INOX, tandis que le second n'a encore jamais réalisé ce type de production.

L'objectif est d'accompagner le déploiement de cette nouvelle activité sur le second site, en s'appuyant sur les savoir-faire existants, tout en assurant la coordination, la transmission des compétences et l'harmonisation des méthodes de fabrication entre les équipes.

Cette mission nécessite une forte présence terrain, une solide expertise technique en chaudronnerie nucléaire et d'excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie pour fédérer les équipes et accompagner le changement.

Missions

  • Piloter et coordonner les activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés destinés au secteur nucléaire.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'organisation des ateliers de fabrication.

  • Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle activité de fabrication INOX sur un site industriel n'ayant jamais réalisé ce type de production.

  • S'appuyer sur l'expertise du site maîtrisant déjà la fabrication INOX pour faciliter le transfert de savoir-faire et de bonnes pratiques vers le second site.

  • Assurer la coordination technique et opérationnelle entre les deux sites de fabrication.

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre les premières lignes directrices et les méthodes de fabrication.

  • Concevoir, définir et mettre en place les gabarits et outillages nécessaires à la fabrication.

  • Accompagner la fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable, notamment à partir de tôles de 4 mm d'épaisseur.

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel et l'accompagnement technique des équipes de fabrication.

  • Participer activement à la formation des équipes et à leur montée en compétences sur les procédés de fabrication INOX.

  • Favoriser la communication, le partage des connaissances et l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les équipes des différents sites.

  • Structurer et formaliser les méthodes de fabrication ainsi que la documentation technique associée.

  • Élaborer et mettre à jour les documents nécessaires au suivi et à l'organisation de la production.

  • Apporter un appui technique et méthodologique aux équipes afin de garantir le bon démarrage des activités de fabrication.

  • Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles méthodes et pratiques industrielles.


  • Formation technique de niveau ingénieur ou expérience significative en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie.

  • Minimum 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie, principalement acquise dans le secteur nucléaire.

  • Expérience confirmée en pilotage de fabrication chaudronnée dans un environnement nucléaire.

  • Solide expertise technique en fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable.

  • Bonne connaissance des procédés de fabrication et de transformation de tôles INOX.

  • Expérience dans la mise en place, l'organisation ou le développement d'ateliers de fabrication.

  • Capacité à définir des méthodes de fabrication, des gammes opératoires et des gabarits de production.

  • Maîtrise de la documentation technique et des méthodes de fabrication industrielles.

  • Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment du Pack Office, pour la rédaction, la structuration et le suivi documentaire.

  • Expérience en encadrement fonctionnel, pilotage et accompagnement d'équipes de production.

  • Capacité à transmettre ses connaissances, à former les équipes et à accompagner leur montée en compétences.

  • Excellent communicant, capable de créer du lien entre les équipes, de faciliter les échanges entre les sites et de faire adhérer les collaborateurs aux nouvelles méthodes de travail.

  • Qualités pédagogiques, sens de l'écoute et capacité à fédérer des équipes présentant différents niveaux d'expertise.

  • Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer une activité industrielle en phase de démarrage.

  • Forte orientation terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à intervenir dans des environnements industriels exigeants.

  • Maitrise de la norme NF EN 1090.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Aera Technology is a pioneer in the growing category of Decision Intelligence Platforms and a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for 2026– the technology to digitize, augment, and automate decision-making processes with AI and machine learning. Through our AI decision automation platform, Aera Decision Cloud™, we are helping the best-known brands in the world make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Privately-held and VC-funded, we have a global team of over 400 Aeranauts – and we’re growing. We deliver Decision Intelligence innovation and services that enable enterprises to automate and scale decision making with accuracy and speed. We continue to be the trusted choice of market leaders for our proven ability to generate value and unlock opportunities that were previously unattainable. 
 
The Principal Solution Engineer supports sales efforts throughout the sales cycle to win new customers, as well as retain and expand existing customers. You will be a key contributor and subject matter expert, owning vital activities that help prospects and customers navigate their selection and decision-making process.  You will be the "tip of the spear" in our go-to-market strategy, working closely with our Product Management and Marketing teams, providing feedback on market requirements, helping to drive the product development roadmap. 
 
The ideal candidate will currently live in the Paris metropolitan area, and be able to work in office on a hybrid basis, when not traveling.

Responsibilities
  • Effectively articulate the value and differentiators of Aera’s Decision Intelligence platform in initial and ongoing client meetings and discussions.
  • Conduct standard and customized live demos within Aera’s demo environment, tailored to each prospect’s business challenges and objectives
  • Learn to build Decision Intelligence Skills within the Aera Workspace to design innovative, customer-specific demos and showcase Aera’s capabilities efficiently.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Aera’s library of Decision Intelligence Skills to inspire customers and illustrate transformative use cases.
  • Drive proof of concept (POC), proof of value (POV), and skill-building initiation workshops
  • Facilitate or support benefit assessments, ROI analyses, and business case development to demonstrate tangible value creation.
  • Contribute to proposal development, RFx responses, and solution documentation in collaboration with sales and delivery teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Delivery and Customer Success teams to define and present compelling solution deployment roadmaps.
  • Lead discovery sessions, design thinking workshops, and executive presentations to align solutions with customer priorities.
  • Use energetic, consultative storytelling to convey the business value and transformative potential of Aera’s Decision Intelligence platform.
  • Combine a strong foundation in data, analytics, and enterprise technology with business acumen to engage both technical and business audiences effectively.

    • About You
  • 10+ years experience with 3+ years in a pre-sales role for an enterprise software firm
  • Supply Chain Operations Management exp i.e., Procurement, Manufacturing, Distribution, Inventory Management etc.
  • Experience in Data Science / Machine Learning a plus
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills
  • Well versed in process manufacturing and CPG, Chemicals, Pharma, F&B etc.
  • Experience with value engineering and business case development
  • Experience writing proposals and SOWs
  • Bachelor’s degree, STEM Engineering or Computer Science; Master’s degree pref.
  • Ability to travel ~25% of the time
    • If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you’re in the right place. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, we're a series C start-up, with teams in Mountain View, San Francisco (California), Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca (Romania), Paris (France), Munich (Germany), London (UK), Pune (India), and Sydney (Australia).  So join us, and let’s build this!
     
    Aera Technology is an equal opportunity employer. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

That is where you come in. 

As Chief Engineer, you will be one of the most important technical leaders at Hypersonica. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. 

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. 

If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. 


What you'll do
  • Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. 
  • Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. 
  • Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. 
  • Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. 
  • Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. 
  • Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. 
  • Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. 
  • Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. 
  • Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. 
  • Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. 
  • Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. 
  • Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. 
  • Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. 

    • Who you are
  • An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. 
  • Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. 
  • Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. 
  • Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. 
  • Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. 
  • Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. 
  • Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. 
  • Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. 
  • Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. 
  • Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. 
  • Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. 
  • Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. 
  • Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. 

    • You might have come from

    There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. 

    You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer. 

    You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. 

    We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. 


    What we offer
  • The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. 
  • A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. 
  • Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. 
  • Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. 
  • The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. 
  • The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. 
  • The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. 

    • The person we are looking for

    We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. 

    We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. 

    Someone who can bring clarity to complexity without slowing the organisation down. 

    If that sounds like you, come and build it with us.

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).

Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs :
 
1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving)
- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé.
- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers.

- Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU).
- Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD).
- Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel.

Monitoring avancé : Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives.
Collaboration transverse : Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production.
Évangélisation : Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science.

* Solide expérience sur les plateformes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et l'IaC (Terraform est un plus).
* Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps : MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes.

- Expérience : Vous avez une expérience significative dans le déploiement de modèles ML en production (batch ou temps réel).
- Mindset :
* Rigueur absolue sur la qualité du code et l'automatisation.
* Goût pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture complexes.
* Capacité à travailler dans des environnements techniques hétérogènes.
