Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fjellfix Trysil AS er et lokalt bemanningsbyrå. Vi formidler dyktige og pålitelige medarbeidere til ulike aktører i Trysil-området. Vårt hovedfokus er å sikre rett person på rett plass, spesielt innen renhold og eiendomsservice under den travle vintersesongen. Som arbeidsgiver hos oss får du trygge rammer og god oppfølging.

jobs.title: Gårdsarbeider – 100 % fast stilling i Gildeskål
jobs.description:
Landbrukstjenester Salten og Lofoten SA søker på vegne av en av våre medlemsbønder etter en dyktig og pålitelig gårdsarbeider til 100 % fast stilling på et moderne gårdsbruk med melkerobot. Stillingen er på en allsidig gård på Jelstad i Gildeskål, med produksjon av melk og gris. Her får du en variert arbeidshverdag med både husdyrstell, gårdsarbeid og bruk av maskiner. Om jobben

Som gårdsarbeider vil du bli en viktig del av den daglige driften på gården. Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere gjennom året og tilpasses driften og sesongen.

Arbeidet vil blant annet kunne bestå av:

  • Daglig stell og oppfølging av storfe og gris

  • Arbeid knyttet til melkeproduksjon

  • Fôring, renhold og annet fjøsarbeid

  • Vedlikehold og praktiske oppgaver på gården

  • Andre forefallende oppgaver som naturlig hører til gårdsdriften

Du vil få en variert arbeidsdag hvor det er viktig å kunne ta ansvar, se hva som må gjøres og bidra til at gården fungerer godt i det daglige. Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har erfaring fra landbruk og gjerne fra husdyrproduksjon

  • Har interesse for dyr og gårdsdrift

  • Er praktisk anlagt og liker å ta i et tak

  • Kan arbeide selvstendig, men også samarbeide godt med andre

  • Er ansvarsbevisst, stabil og pålitelig

  • Har interesse for teknisk utstyr

  • Ønskelig med maskinførerbevis

  • Har førerkort klasse B

Erfaring fra melk eller svineproduksjon er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav. Den rette personen vil få nødvendig opplæring i arbeidsoppgavene. Om Jelstad og Gildeskål

Jelstad ligger i Gildeskål kommune, omgitt av flott nordnorsk natur. Området byr på nærhet til sjø, fjell og gode muligheter for friluftsliv, samtidig som du er en del av et aktivt og tradisjonsrikt landbruksmiljø. Kort vei til storbyen Bodø.

Gården har en topp moderne fjøs hvor det er satt fokus på automatisering og effektivisering.

Gildeskål er en kommune hvor landbruk, fiskeri og annen næringsvirksomhet står sterkt. For den som trives med livet på landet, er dette en fin mulighet til å kombinere en praktisk og variert jobb med nærhet til naturen.

Vi tilbyr

  • 100 % fast stilling

  • Tiltredelse 1. januar 2027

  • En variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag

  • Arbeid med både storfe og gris

  • Mulighet til å utvikle kompetansen innen husdyrhold

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Lønn etter avtale og gjeldende avtaler

  • Oppfølging og ansettelse gjennom Landbrukstjenester Salten og Lofoten SA

  • Hjelp til å skaffe bolig

Dette er en stilling for deg som liker dyr, maskiner og praktisk arbeid, og som ønsker en fast arbeidsplass innen landbruket. Høres dette interessant ut? Ta gjerne kontakt for mer informasjon om stillingen og gården.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Landbrukstjenester Salten og Lofoten SA er et samvirkeforetak som leverer avløsertjenester til bønder i regionen. Vi sørger for kvalifisert arbeidskraft ved sykdom, ferie og annet fravær, slik at dyrevelferd og gårdsdrift ivaretas. Vi arbeider også med rekruttering, kompetanseheving og beredskap for landbruket. Vårt mål er å gjøre hverdagen enklere for bonden og bidra til et bærekraftig og framtidsrettet landbruk.

jobs.title: Prosessingeniør – bli med og forme fremtidens fabrikk på Skoppum!
jobs.description:
Norautron er i vekst og søker en ny prosessingeniør som vil spille en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av vårt fremtidige produksjonsmiljø.

Dette er mer enn en tradisjonell ingeniørstilling. Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å utvikle, forbedre og automatisere produksjonsprosesser i et av Norges ledende EMS-miljøer. Du vil jobbe tett med produksjon, kvalitet, innkjøp, lager og salg for å sikre robuste prosesser, høy kvalitet og effektiv produksjon.

I løpet av neste år skal Norautron flytte inn i en ny høyteknologisk fabrikk på Skoppum.

Som prosessingeniør får du en unik mulighet til å påvirke hvordan fremtidens produksjon skal utformes gjennom automasjon, digitalisering og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Overvåke og forbedre produksjonsprosesser ved hjelp av dataanalyse og nøkkeltall som SPC, Yield, DPMO og rework-rate

  • Evaluere, kvalifisere og implementere nytt produksjonsutstyr, automatiseringsløsninger og ny prosessteknologi

  • Optimalisere produksjonsflyt og arbeidsmetoder med Lean-prinsipper som fundament

  • Samarbeide tett med produksjon, salg, innkjøp, lager og kvalitet

  • Bidra i avviksbehandling, rotårsaksanalyser og korrigerende tiltak

  • Utvikle arbeidsmetoder for å sikre stabile og robuste prosesser

  • Delta i teknologiprosjekter og forbedringsarbeid på tvers av organisasjonen

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Bachelorgrad innen et relevant teknisk fagområde, for eksempel prosess/automasjon, elektronikk, produksjonsteknikk, maskinteknikk eller tilsvarende.

  • Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning

  • Erfaring fra produksjonsmiljø, gjerne innen elektronikkproduksjon, automasjon eller annen teknisk industri

  • God teknisk forståelse og interesse for problemløsning

  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

  • Gode IT-kunnskaper

  • Erfaring med eller interesse for standarder og forbedringsmetodikk som IPC, ISO, Lean og 8D er en fordel

Vi tror du vil lykkes hos oss dersom du

  • Trives med å være til stede i produksjonen og arbeide tett på mennesker, utstyr og prosesser

  • Er nysgjerrig og motiveres av å finne bedre løsninger

  • Har interesse for ny teknologi, maskiner og optimalisering

  • Jobber strukturert og analytisk

  • Trives med å omsette idéer til praktiske forbedringer

  • Liker å samarbeide med mennesker fra ulike fagområder

  • Tar initiativ og følger oppgaver helt i mål

  • Ønsker faglig utvikling og kontinuerlig læring

Vi tilbyr

  • Arbeidssted Horten (nytt bygg på Skoppum fra sommeren 2027)

  • Et inkluderende og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø

  • En nøkkelrolle som gir gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

  • Fleksitid og konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Kantineordning

  • Gratis parkering og treningsabonnement på Sporty

  • Firmaleiligheter på Hemsedal

Om arbeidsgiveren

Norautron AS er en ledende kontraktsprodusent av avansert elektronikk og elektromekaniske produkter, med hovedkontor og produksjon i Horten. Siden etableringen i 1989 har selskapet utviklet seg til å bli en internasjonal produksjonspartner for en rekke ledende aktører.

Norautron tilbyr tjenester gjennom hele produktets livsløp - fra prototyping og industrialisering til elektronikkproduksjon, elektromekanisk montasje, mekanikk, systemintegrasjon og ferdige produkter. Selskapet har virksomhet i flere land og betjener kunder i et internasjonalt marked.

Norautron leverer produkter og løsninger til kunder innen en rekke krevende markeder, blant annet maritim og havteknologi, energi, forsvar og luftfart, connectivity og computing, industri og helseteknologi. Felles for markedene er høye krav til teknologi, kvalitet, leveringspresisjon og pålitelighet.

Norautrons visjon er å være kundenes foretrukne leverandør. Kompetanse, engasjement, effektivitet og kvalitet står sentralt, sammen med et tydelig fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring.

Norautron er inne i en spennende utviklingsfase og gjør nå en av de største investeringene i selskapets historie.

Sommeren 2027 flytter virksomheten inn i et nytt og moderne anlegg på Skoppum. Her skal den lokale produksjonen samles under ett tak, samtidig som kapasiteten økes og legges til rette for enda bedre flyt og samhandling mellom produksjon, lager og logistikk.

Interessert?

Ta gjerne kontakt dersom du ønsker å vite mer om stillingen.

Pål Folmo

Process Manager

Paal.Folmo@norautron.com

+47 924 17 891

jobs.title: CNC-programmerer
jobs.description:
Shape AS in Skodje is looking for an experienced CNC programmer to join our five-person team. We deliver precision machining for demanding industrial and defence projects, and you'll have direct influence over how we build and produce.

Hva vi ser etter

We're looking for someone who's self-driven, hands-on, and takes real ownership of their work. You're comfortable figuring things out independently, communicate clearly with the rest of the team, and enjoy solving problems as they come up on the shop floor. This role rewards people who like to automate repetitive tasks and think about production with a heuristic mindset --- spotting patterns and better ways of doing things rather than just following a fixed process. We value initiative and a genuine interest in your craft as much as years on paper --- if you're strong in some areas and still growing in others, we're open to that.

That said, here's what typically makes someone succeed in this role:

  • Experience as a CNC programmer using CAM (3+ years is a good guideline, not a hard cutoff --- training in NX CAM specifically will be provided if you have strong CAM experience on other platforms)

  • Strong understanding of CAD and machining principles

  • Comfortable working independently, at pace, and meeting tight deadlines

  • Good problem-solving instincts and interest in technical challenges

  • Strong communication skills

Arbeidsoppgaver

As a CNC Programmer with us, you will:

  • Develop and refine CNC programs using NX CAM
  • Optimize production processes to increase efficiency and reduce costs
  • Troubleshoot and resolve programming issues during production
  • Stay current with new CNC programming techniques and technology

You'll work closely with the rest of the team to push production forward, and you'll see the results of your work on the shop floor quickly.

Vi tilbyr
  • Competitive salary
  • Real influence , your work is visible and valued, not lost in a large hierarchy
  • Thorough training and genuine opportunities for professional development - Varied, hands-on work across industries
  • A tight-knit team and a great working environment

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Shape AS is a precision CNC job shop based in Skodje, delivering 3D modeling, prototyping, product development, reverse engineering, and mold/tooling production. Our five-person team works with modern machinery and technology across a wide range of industries, from vacuum forming and composite tooling to metal casting and complex machining. Our work regularly supports UAV, and other high-precision industrial projects. We're a small, close-knit team where every person's work is visible and valued. As we grow, we're looking for people who want real ownership over what they build, not just a seat in a large hierarchy.

Vi søker deg som er genuint interessert i barns trivsel i barnehagen og som ser barnets beste i alt du gjør. Er du leken, glad i friluftsliv og fysisk fostring? Da ønsker vi å høre fra deg!

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du tenker barnets beste i alt du gjør

  • Du deltar aktivt i lek og aktiviteter med barna

  • Du er en tydelig, men varm voksen/leder

Arbeidsoppgaver

Pedagogisk arbeid

  • ansvar for det administrative og pedagogiske arbeidet på din avdeling. Dette omfatter blant annet planlegging, gjennomføring og evaluering av ukeplaner, periodeplaner og årsplanen.

  • ansvar for at aktiviteter, ukeplaner, periodeplaner og årsplanen samsvarer med hverandre og barnehagens satsningsområder.

  • ansvar for et godt samarbeid rundt det spesialpedagogiske arbeidet på avdelingen.

  • ansvar for å tilrettelegge dagen slik at barna opplever trivsel, trygghet, læreglede og utvikling, og får dekket sine behov med hensyn til mat, trivsel og omsorg.

  • ansvar for å følge opp barns medvirkning.

Praktiske ansvars oppgaver

  • ansvar for å vite hvem som er på din avdeling til enhver tid og melde fra til styrer ved fravær, sykdom eller ved behov for ekstra bemanning.

  • ansvar for at arbeidstiden blir holdt på din avdeling, og ansvaret for å gi tillatelse til avspasering.

  • sette opp turnus for din avdeling.

Ansvar overfor aktivitetsledere/fagarbeidere

  • ansvar for å følge opp at primærkontaktenes oppgaver blir gjort.

  • ansvar for å følge opp at aktivitetsledere/fagarbeidere gjennomfører planlegging, og oppdeling av barnegruppene på daglig basis.

  • ansvar for veiledning, oppfølging og ros/ris av avdelingens øvrige personale, og sørge for at det øvrige personalet får uttale seg om aktuelle temaer.

  • medansvar for å sørge for et godt samarbeid på tvers av avdelingene.

  • ansvaret for å informere avdelingen om nye barn og å følge opp i tilvenningsfasen.

  • ansvar for å planlegge og gjennomføre foreldresamtaler, og for å sørge for et godt foreldre- samarbeid.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode lønns- og pensjonsbetingelser. Som nyutdannet og ny i yrket, begynner du på lønnstrinn, 8 års ansiennitet.

  • Et fagmiljø med mulighet for faglig utvikling

  • Som ansatt får du tilgang til å leie leilighet i Kvitfjell og i Hurdal, til rimelig sum.

  • Godt arbeidsmiljø

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hoppensprett Fjellfoten har 94 barn, barnehageåret 2026-2027. Barna er fordelt på 2 småbarnsavdelinger og 3 storebarnsavdelinger.

I tillegg til et stort uteområde, har vi kort vei til skog- og friluftsområder, hvilket vi bruker mye!

Hoppenspretts profil er fysisk fostring og motorikk, friluftsliv og aktivitetsbasert læring og dannelsesprogrammet "Lederen i meg".

Vi arbeider etter en aktivitets- og mestringspedagogikk, som vil si at vi hver dag legger til rette for lek og læring i små grupper, der innhold og form er tilpasset barnas ferdighets og modenhetsnivå.

Våre verdier: Lek deg klok, lev i bevegelse, lær for livet, lederskap og latter.

I Hoppensprett ønsker vi å inspirere alle, både små og store, til et liv i bevegelse, en sunn innstilling til kosthold og mosjon, og til å både gi og motta det lille ekstra!

jobs.title: Materials Chemist / Scientist - replacing Teflon/PFAS
jobs.description:
Nanize AS, based in Narvik, Norway and established in 2019, is developing technologies for replacement of Teflon/PFAS in many application areas. Current commercial efforts are focused on cookware/bakeware, release liners, technical fabrics and membranes and packaging, among others. Nanize has a 400m2 lab in Narvik, with an international team of 6 Master of Science, and 2 PhDs (Chemistry & Materials Science).

Nanize offers a job opportunity for an enthusiastic and innovative Materials Chemist/Scientist to join its international R&D team. Main duties will include optimisation of functionalised additives and developing of coating formulations for improved performance.

The successful candidate will be a resident of, or nearby Narvik, observant and meticulous and be fluent in English, the company's working language.

**Start date:**Immediate.

Requirements:

**·**MSc or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, or related areas.

· Experience in functional coatings, particularly based on sol-gel and polysilazane chemistry.

· Understanding of materials' surface state and its impact on coating performance in aggressive chemical and thermal environments.

· Experimental and theoretical knowledge of the physical chemistry and solution thermodynamics of macromolecular and colloidal systems, e.g. using light scattering methods.

· Experience in quality assurance of coating formulation additives.

Instructions to Applicants:

Send your application to post@nanize.com together with your CV. Also, please provide a short (3 minutes max.) video answer the following questions:

  1. Material Science Tetrahedron is a mental framework which binds all research activities together. Which of the four nodes excites you the most and why?

  2. What factors do you think have held back novel materials such as carbon nanotubes from large-scale applications?

  3. Independent or collaborative research -- which is more useful in a small team?

Only applicants that follow the instructions will be considered.

Als Mitarbeiter:in der DB Zeitarbeit arbeitest du in zeitlich befristeten Einsätzen für die Geschäftsfelder der Deutschen Bahn, sammelst wertvolle Berufserfahrung und eignest dir auf diese Weise neue Fähigkeiten für deinen weiteren Berufsweg an. Häufig finden unsere Zeitarbeitnehmenden auf dieser Reise ihre berufliche Heimat innerhalb des DB-Konzerns.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Zeitarbeitnehmer:in im Auftrag der Deutschen Bahn AG für einen Einsatz als Solution Architect – Automation (w/m/d) für den Standort Frankfurt am Main. Als Zeitarbeitnehmer:in erbringst du deine Arbeitsleistung im genannten Geschäftsfeld, während du dein Arbeitsverhältnis mit uns, der DB Zeitarbeit GmbH, abschließt.Deine Aufgaben:- Konzeption, Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Automatisierungslösungen für geschäftskritische Kernprozesse mit hohem Transaktionsvolumen sowie Sicherstellung einer skalierbaren, nachhaltigen technischen Architektur- Hands-on Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung wiederverwendbarer Business Capabilities sowie technischer Standards, Richtlinien und Architekturvorgaben zur Förderung einer unternehmensweiten Automatisierung und Effizienzsteigerung- Evaluierung, Pilotierung und Integration neuer Technologien (z. B. Generative AI, Agenten-KI, Process Mining) zur Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen und zur Umsetzung strategischer Architektur- und Innovationsziele- Sicherstellung von Qualität, Performance und Skalierbarkeit der Automatisierungslösungen durch aktive technische Mitarbeit, Architektur-Reviews, technische Abnahmen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Lösungen- Fachliche Steuerung externer und internationaler Umsetzungspartner durch Definition technischer Anforderungen, Strukturierung von Arbeitspaketen und Vorgabe von Qualitätsstandards zur termingerechten Projektrealisierung- Förderung des technischen Know-how-Aufbaus im Team durch Pair Programming, Tech-Talks und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Governance- und Compliance-Einheiten zur Entwicklung zukunftsfähiger Automatisierungslösungen nach dem Prinzip „Architect who codes“Dein Profil:- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fachinformatiker:in, IT-Studium (Diplom / Master) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Prozessautomatisierung und Digitalisierung von Geschäftsprozessen- Praxiserfahrung bei der Integration von KI-Lösungen in bestehende Prozesslandschaften- Fundierte Kenntnisse in APIs, Microsoft Power Platform und Camunda- Kenntnisse in Python, FEEL sowie mindestens einer weiteren Programmiersprache- Erfahrung mit Dokumentenverarbeitungstechnologien wie OCR, Objekterkennung oder Document Intelligence Services- Sichere Kommunikation in deutscher Sprache (mindestens C1) und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber unterschiedlichen StakeholdernDas ist uns wichtig:Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.Deine Vorteile- Du schaffst Großes und bekommst nicht weniger zurück: Ein tarifvertraglich geregeltes Gehaltspaket inkl. verschiedener Ausgleichmodelle für Überstunden, Weihnachtsgeld sowie vielfältige Nebenleistungen.- Bis zu 34 Tage Urlaub: Bei uns kannst du selbst entscheiden, ob du mehr Urlaub nehmen, deine Arbeitszeit verkürzen oder gerne mehr verdienen möchtest. Je nachdem, wie es zu deinem Leben passt.- Wir bieten dir 16 Freifahrten innerhalb Deutschlands pro Jahr und weitere Fahrvergünstigungen wie z.B. DB Job-Ticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg. Darüber hinaus gibt es günstige Mitnahmemöglichkeiten für Familie und Freunde.- Faszinierende Projekte und Aufgaben bei einer der vielfältigsten Arbeitgeberinnen des Landes fordern dein Können und warten auf deine Handschrift.- Wir sind deine zusätzliche Einstiegsmöglichkeit in die Konzernwelt der Deutschen Bahn. Häufig entwickeln sich dabei aus unseren Zeitarbeitsverträgen Direktanstellungen bei der DB.- Durch verschiedene Einsätze hast du die Möglichkeit, ein breites Spektrum an Erfahrungen zu sammeln: Geht ein Einsatz zu Ende, haben wir meistens schon die nächste Einsatzmöglichkeit für dich parat.Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - (Fintech) (Bachelor Professional - IT (Softwareentwicklung))
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionBig systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll build and scale the internal Payments engine that handles payments for the entire Delivery Hero. Your work keeps checkout reliable and payment failures low for customers across our markets.Our Fintech team builds Wallet, Payment, and Anti-Fraud solutions worldwide. You’ll focus on the core payment features that manage the lifecycle of different payment flows, ensuring consistency and reliability of payment operations.Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit. Your work will support our path to profitability by creating financial flexibility for users and enabling smooth transactions across our markets.- Design, build, and deliver highly scalable software systems in complex, global environments used across more than 70 countries, applying secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle- Lead backend engineering efforts with a focus on distributed systems, using Java, Kotlin, Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit, and drive architectural decisions for your features with design patterns, SOLID principles, and Domain-Driven Design- Own services end-to-end with a “you build it, you run it” mindset, including infrastructure automation and continuous deployment- Define and apply testing strategies across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end levels- Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across multi-region, distributed microservices, and promote reliability, on-call, and observability best practices- Mentor teammates and evangelize engineering best practices to continuously improve how the team builds and ships softwareQualifications- Proven experience designing and delivering software systems in complex business domains at global scale, within fintech or payments- Deep backend engineering expertise, with a strong preference for distributed systems- Hands-on expertise in Java, Kotlin, Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit- A strong engineering ownership mindset with a passion for automation, CI/CD, and reliability- Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity in approaching complex challenges- A high bar for quality, performance, and attention to detailNice to have- Experience in payments, wallet, or anti-fraud domains- Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g. Kafka)- Experience mentoring other engineersAdditional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank,  Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and check out more information about moving to Berlin.- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire)  If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com (inclusion@deliveryhero.com) .You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

jobs.title: Senior KI- Entwickler INTERN m/w/d (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: (Im Rahmen einer Direkt-/Personalvermittlung suchen wir für einen Kunden aus dem südlichen Raum Stuttgart einen Senior KI-Entwickler m/w/d zur unbefristeten Festanstellung zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt. Der Kunde ist ein IT-Beratungshaus mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition – sehr stabil und modern oder kurz: toller Arbeitgeber, tolle Perspektiven - hoher Homeoffice-Anteil.Es wird intern ein Produkt entwickelt – KEINE externen Projekte/Einsätze!!Worum geht´s?Aktuell wird eine moderne Web-Anwendung im Bildungsbereich entwickelt (internes Projekt des IT-Beratungshauses).  Hierfür sucht der Kunde eine(n) Senior KI- Entwickler/in, der das Produkt von Frontend bis Backend mitgestaltet und technisch voranbringt.Ihre Rolle: Als Senior KI-Entwickler verantworten Sie die Konzeption, Entwicklung und den produktiven Betrieb unserer LLM-Anwendungen – von der Architektur über das Prototyping bis zum skalierbaren Deployment. Sie arbeiten eng mit Produktentwicklern, Data und Engineering zusammen und bringen technische Tiefe sowie eine pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität mitAufgaben:- Design und Entwicklung von RAG-Pipelines und LLM-Anwendungen mit LangChain – von der Idee bis zur Produktion- Aufbau und Betrieb von Vektordatenbanken (z. B. Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector): Embedding-Strategien, Chunking, Indexierung und Retrieval-Optimierung- Monitoring und Optimierung von LLM-Workflows mit LangSmith – Tracing, Evaluierung, Prompt-Optimierung und Qualitätssicherung- Konzeption von Lösungen basierend auf Transformer-Architekturen, inkl. Auswahl, Fine-Tuning bzw. Anbindung passender Modelle (Open Source und kommerziell)- Optimierung für Performance, Kosten und Latenz im produktiven Einsatz- Etablierung technischer Standards, Mentoring von Junior-Entwicklern und Mitgestaltung unserer KI-RoadmapSie bringen mit:- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon nachweislich in KI-/ML-Projekten- Fundiertes Verständnis von Transformer-Modellen und den Grundlagen großer Sprachmodelle (LLMs): Tokenisierung, Embeddings, Attention, Kontextfenster, Prompting- Sicherer Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken und Retrieval-Augmented-Generation (RAG)- Praktische Erfahrung mit den Frameworks LangChain und LangSmith- Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit APIs gängiger LLM-Anbieter (z. jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. jobs.description: Požadavky:-    dovršení věku 18 let,-    občanství České republiky,-    ukončené střední vzdělání s maturitní zkouškou,-    bezúhonnost podle zákona o obecní policii,-    spolehlivost podle zákona o obecní policii,-    zdravotní způsobilost k výkonu práce strážníka,-    rozšířené zbrojní oprávnění výhodou; uchazeč, který není jeho držitelem, je povinen splnit podmínky pro jeho získání ve lhůtě stanovené zaměstnavatelem,-    řidičské oprávnění skupiny B,-    dobré komunikační schopnosti, odpovídající úroveň vystupování a jednání s lidmi, důslednost, schopnost kvalifikovaného a včasného plnění úkolů a flexibilita.Informace o pracovním místě:-    druhem práce je zabezpečování místních záležitostí veřejného pořádku dle zákona o obecní policii a dalších zvláštních právních předpisů se zaměřením na: ochranu bezpečnosti osob a majetku, dodržování pravidel občanského soužití, ochranu veřejného pořádku, dodržování obecně závazných vyhlášek a nařízení obce, provádění dohledu nad bezpečností a plynulostí silničního provozu, podílení se na prevenci kriminality, odhalování přestupků.-    pracovní poměr na dobu určitou v prvním roce, dále pak na dobu neurčitou.-    výkon služby je vykonáván v nepřetržitém provozu podle rozpisu směn. -    do doby získání „Osvědčení“ pobírá čekatel nástupní plat odpovídající 5. platové třídě. Po zařazení do přímého výkonu služby je strážník zařazen do 8. platové třídy s poskytnutím osobního a zvláštního příplatku, příplatku za směnnost, příplatku za noční práci, za práci v sobotu a v neděli, za práci přesčas nebo ve svátek. -    stabilní zaměstnání, zaměstnanecké benefity (příspěvek na stravování a na penzijní pojištění, Flexi Pass, sick days a další), možnost profesního růstu (vzdělávání v oboru).Předpoklady k podání přihlášky do výběrového řízení:Přihlášku může podat občan, který splňuje výše uvedené podmínky a požadavky. Obsah, přílohy, způsob a termín podání přihlášky:Přihláška musí obsahovat, na jaké pracovní místo zájemce přihlášku podává, jméno, příjmení a titul, datum a místo narození, státní příslušnost, číslo dokladu totožnosti, místo trvalého pobytu (též skutečného, pokud se uchazeč zdržuje na jiné adrese), telefonní a e-mailový kontakt, datum a podpis zájemce.K přihlášce se připojí:-    nestrukturovaný pracovní a osobní životopis psaný vlastní rukou,-    motivační dopis,-    výpis z Rejstříku trestů ne starší 3 měsíců,-    ověřená kopie dokladu o nejvyšším dosaženém vzdělání,-    kopie vysvědčení z posledního ročníku základní školy (z osmé nebo deváté třídy). Přihlášky se podávají na podatelně MěÚ nebo zasílají na adresu:    Městský úřad Jindřichův Hradec    Klášterská 135/II    Jindřichův Hradec    PSČ 377 01Přihlášky na předepsaném tiskopise (viz příloha) je nutné podat v zalepené obálce označené „Neotvírat – VŘ – strážník - MěPol“ nejpozději do 31.12.2026 do 10:00 hod.

jobs.title: Chef för operativ ledning vid Räddningstjänsten Östra Götaland
jobs.description: Vid Räddningstjänsten Östra Götaland arbetar vi alla för samma mål. Att göra olyckorna färre och skadorna mindre. Vi måste kunna sprida kunskap, hantera många sorters olyckor och möta medmänniskor. Och vi måste finnas där för varandra. Vår styrka är att vi har så många olika styrkor. Vilken är din? Det är stor chans att den passar in hos oss.BeskrivningSom chef för avdelningen operativ ledning vid Räddningstjänsten Östra Götaland kommer du att spela en avgörande roll i vårt samhälle. Du kommer att leda och utveckla vårt operativa team, se till att vi alltid är förberedda att möta olika typer av situationer med kompetens och trygghet.Vill du vara med och göra skillnad? Om du har en passion för att leda, kommunicera och arbeta i en dynamisk miljö, tveka inte att söka!ArbetsuppgifterSom chef för operativ ledning är du chef för en avdelning som driver vårt arbete med övergripande ledning och insatsledning. Inom avdelningen finns vår räddningscentral (RC) och våra insatsledare. Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat att:    Utveckla vår räddningstjänstverksamhet i linje med krav i lagstiftning och andra typer av styrdokument.     Leda utveckling av ledningsförmåga gällande insatsledning och övergripande ledning där du använder din helhetssyn för nå resultat.    Leda arbete med operativ planering och alarmering.    Ansvara för och utveckla ledningsfunktionerna regional insatsledare och insatsledare för att säkerställa högsta möjliga kompetens och effektivitet    Leda strategisk utveckling av vår räddningscentral (RC).    Aktivt samverka och bygga relationer med andra aktörer för att utveckla vår räddningstjänstverksamhet.    Skapa en positiv och stödjande arbetsmiljö som främjar samarbete, utveckling och initiativtagande.KvalifikationerVi söker en engagerad och initiativrik chef för operativ ledning vid Räddningstjänsten Östra Götaland. Vi tror att du är brandingenjör med kompetens att vara räddningsledare inom kommunal räddningstjänst. Vi tror att du hos oss kan ha en beredskapsfunktion som regional insatsledare eller vakthavande räddningschef.För att trivas i denna roll är det viktigt att du har en stor personlig mognad och förmåga att ta egna initiativ. Du ska kunna arbeta självständigt men också kunna samarbeta effektivt med andra eftersom vi värdesätter lagarbete och gemenskap i vår verksamhet.Vi ser gärna att du har följande kvalifikationer:    Personlig mognad – förmåga att hantera utmanande situationer med lugn och stabilitet.    Initiativtagande – villighet att ta ledningen och föreslå förbättringar i arbetet.    Självgående – förmåga att prioritera uppgifter och arbeta mot uppsatta mål utan övervakning.    Samarbetsförmåga – du trivs i team och bygger relationer för att uppnå gemensamma mål.    Muntlig kommunikation – du kan uttrycka dig tydligt och effektivt, både internt och externt.    Ledarskap – du leder med passion och inspirerar andra i deras arbete.    Helhetssyn – du har förmåga att se både detaljer och större sammanhang, vilket är avgörande i vårt arbete.Om du känner att du besitter dessa egenskaper och en vilja att göra skillnad i samhället, ser vi fram emot att ta del av din ansökan!Om ossRäddningstjänsten Östra Götaland är ett kommunalförbund som har fem medlemmar: Linköpings, Norrköpings, Söderköpings, Valdemarsviks och Åtvidabergs kommuner. Vi har cirka 450 medarbetare. En av våra viktigaste uppgifter är att öka säkerhet och förebygga så att olyckor inte behöver hända. Att bidra till att höja människors egen kunskap och förmåga så att var och en ska ha sin egen säkerhet i egna händer är något som vi jobbar intensivt med. Men när olyckan är framme så handlar vårt arbete om att rädda människor, egendom och miljö samt att hjälpa till vid kriser i samhället.Viktigt att vetaVi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats i ständig utveckling, och vi jobbar aktivt med medarbetarskap och ledarskap för att skapa en attraktiv arbetsplats för alla representerade yrkesroller, och både kvinnor och män. Eftersom vi är viktiga för våra invånare är det värdefullt för oss som räddningstjänst att vi speglar samhället. Vi värderar därför kulturell kompetens då vi ser att det tillför ytterligare förståelse, erfarenhet och kunskap i våra möten med invånare samtidigt som det utvecklar vår organisation. Vi värnar om våra medarbetares välmående och arbetar aktivt för en god balans mellan arbete och privatliv, med möjlighet till träning och en hållbar arbetsbelastning. Tjänsten kan komma att säkerhetsklassas enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inom vår verksamhet är samtliga medarbetare krigsplacerade. Din ansökan med tillhörande meritförteckning hanteras i enlighet med de bestämmelser som regleras av GDPR (dataskyddsförordningen). Vi är en drog- och alkoholfri arbetsplats så därför gör vi drogtest med stöd av företagshälsovård innan anställning. Vi följer arbetsrättsliga lagar och vi har kollektivavtal vilket vi ser som en trygghet i arbetslivet. Urvalet av ansökningar görs mot registrerade meriter och utbildningar.Vår styrka är att vi har så många olika styrkor. Så vilken är din? Det är stor chans att den passar in hos oss.Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pfege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pfege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pfegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pfege und Verwaltung. Efzienz für den Träger.

Deine Rolle

Wir befnden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle ist ihr Motor im Bestand: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Customer-Success-Prozess von BringLiesel, von der erfolgreichen Anbindung neuer Einrichtungen bis zu ihrem nachhaltigen Ausbau. Du brauchst dafür beides – eine ausgeprägte Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität für das operative Tagesgeschäft und den strategischen Weitblick, um die Rolle neu zu defnieren und BringLiesel für die Zukunft aufzustellen. Du holst dein Team operativ ab, führst es strategisch und setzt die richtigen Initiativen. Dabei führst du drei Account Manager, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Vom Onboarding bis zum Ausbau: Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einrichtungen – von der Anbindung über die Etablierung im Pfegealltag bis zum kontinuierlichen Ausbau.
  • Wachstum im Bestand: Du stärkst die Durchdringung in den Einrichtungen (mehr Bewohnende pro Einrichtung), baust die Warenkörbe aus und etablierst BringLiesel fest im Alltag der Einrichtung.
  • Führung & Entwicklung: Fachliche und persönliche Führung von drei Account Managern, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.
  • Zusammenspiel mit Marketing: Enge, gestaltende Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing und Digital Customer Experience als zentraler Wachstumshebel.
  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Du defnierst die Rolle neu, setzt die richtigen Initiativen und Prozesse und stellst den Bereich zukunftsfest auf.
  • Steuerung über Kennzahlen: Du machst Durchdringung, Warenkorb und Kundenbindung messbar und sorgst dafür, dass die Kennzahlen auch wirken.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account- oder Bestandskundenmanagement, idealerweise mit Führungsverantwortung.
  • Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Ausbau von Bestandskunden (Durchdringung, Upsell, Warenkorb) –gerne datengetrieben.
  • Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing.
  • Führungskompetenz: Du entwickelst ein kleines Team und gehst als Vorbild voran.
  • Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pfegeumfeld wichtig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Chance, den Customer Success bei BringLiesel neu zu defnieren und für die Zukunftaufzustellen – eine Rolle, die du von Anfang an prägst.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive (Eastern Europe)
Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $190,000.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de känner delaktighet, får rätt förutsättningar och har kul på vägen.Hos oss får du bland annat:✅ Fast månadslön, oavsett uppdrag ✅ Sex veckors betald semester ✅ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kronor per år ✅ Bonusmöjligheter på upp till 2 000 kronor per månad ✅ Kollektivavtal med tjänstepension, försäkringar och föräldraledighetstillägg ✅ Företagshälsovård ✅ Spännande och varierande uppdrag hos ledande teknikföretag ✅ Möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom olika produkter, processer och branscher ✅ Ett engagerat team och regelbundna aktiviteter, nätverksträffar och IKG-eventVarför IKG?På IKG är människan minst lika viktig som tekniken. jobs.title: Manager CTO Office
jobs.description:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.


Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.
