jobs.title: Business Development Representative, CEE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Business fluency in English and Polish

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions condsultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, DACH (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base.

 - Set the bar for product and AI fluency across the team and ensure your team masters Notion’s product and maintains an expert-level knowledge of the AI ecosystem.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluent in German & English




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: COO Property Management (w/m) / Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung
jobs.description:
Unsere Mandantin gehört zu den führenden Anbieterinnen integraler Facility- und Real-Estate-Management-Lösungen in der Schweiz. Als Teil einer internationalen Unternehmens-gruppe ist sie mit einer grossen Organisation an zahlreichen Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz präsent.

Im Zuge der strategischen Neuausrichtung richtet das Unternehmen die operative Führung künftig nach Geschäftsfeldern aus und hat dafür die Funktion COO Real Estate Management neu geschaffen.

Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für das Immobilienmanagement. Sie integrieren die regionalen Bewirtschaftungseinheiten, entwickeln das Geschäftsmodell weiter und treiben die durchgängige Digitalisierung vom Mietvertrag bis zur Fakturierung voran. Sie verstehen es, bestehende Kunden zu pflegen und neue Marktchancen zu realisieren.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung für das operative Bewirtschaftungsgeschäft inklusive P&L, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit

  • Finanzielle Steuerung mit Budgetierung, Forecasts, Business Cases und KPI

  • Führung der regionalen Bewirtschaftungseinheiten sowie zentraler Bereiche wie Vermarktung und Kundenrechnungswesen als integrale Organisation

  • Weiterentwicklung der unterstellten Bereiche

  • Vereinheitlichung von Prozessen, Standards und Steuerungslogiken

  • Weiterentwicklung des Property-Management-Geschäftsmodells mit Blick auf nachhaltiges Wachstum

  • Digitalisierung der Prozesse von Mietvertragsmanagement und Inkasso über Vermarktung bis zum Auftragsmanagement

  • Leitung von Transformations- und Integrationsprojekten inklusive Change Management

  • Mitgestaltung der Gesamtstrategie als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung

Qualifikationen

  • Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Immobilienökonomie, Real Estate Management oder vergleichbar

  • Mehrjährige Führungs- und P&L-Erfahrung im Real Estate Management und in der Bewirtschaftung grösserer Immobilienportfolios

  • Ausgeprägte Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management; Private-Equity-Erfahrung von Vorteil

  • Nachweisbare Transformationserfahrung in Integration, Skalierung und Prozessstandardisierung

  • Erfahrung in der Führung dezentraler Organisationen über mehrere Regionen

  • Digitale Affinität und Verständnis operativer Geschäftsmodelle

  • Starke, integrierende und präsente Führungspersönlichkeit, unternehmerisch und durchsetzungsstark

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, fliessendes Französisch (wird vorausgesetzt) und gute Englischkenntnisse

Arbeitsort: Grossraum Zürich, mit regelmässiger Präsenz an den Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell ist möglich.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse an dieser anspruchsvollen Führungsaufgabe geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen elektronischen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Absolute Diskretion ist selbstverständlich.

Hitchman Partners AG, Bellerivestrasse 3, 8008 Zürich.
Ihr Ansprechpartner ist Arnold Marty.

jobs.description: Om jobbetAvdelning Stadsområde, välfärd och fritid arbetar med att säkerställa en meningsfull fritid för alla barn och unga, erbjuda mötesplatser, trygghets- och brottsförebyggande arbete, folkhälsofrågor, sociala erfarenheter i samhällsplanering, fältverksamhet samt demokrati och inflytandefrågor. Vi bedriver också områdesutveckling i nära samverkar med civilsamhället och andra aktörer i stadsområdet. Avdelningen består av 9 enheter.Nu söker vi enhetschef till en av våra fritidsenheter. Enheten arbetar med att skapa meningsfull fritid till barn och unga. Som enhetschef innebär det att driva och utveckla några av våra öppna mötesplatser för unga. Enheterna har en stor och viktig del i att skapa meningsfulla lov och samverka lokalt för att skapa goda uppväxtvillkor. Verksamheten ska vara trygg, tillgänglig och inkluderande med fokus på att arbeta med barn och ungas delaktighet, inflytande och lärande. Tjänsten är riktad mot de östra delarna av stadsområdet där du ansvarar för tre mötesplatser.Som enhetschef har du personal-, budget-, arbetsmiljö- och verksamhetsansvar. Du tillhör ledningsgrupp tillsammans med övriga enhetschefer och rapporterar till avdelningschef. I stadsområdet är du med och utvecklar arbetet runt barn och unga både vad gäller meningsfull fritid, goda uppväxtvillkor samt tidiga insatser utifrån socialtjänstlagen. Du kommer att ingå i nätverk bestående av andra enhetschefer inom Göteborgs stad.Förvaltningen har en ledarskapsstrategi med fokus på ett modigt och nära ledarskap. Då det i stadsområdet finns stora socioekonomiska utmaningar är det viktigt att ledare har uthållighet i avgörande utvecklingsfrågor, klarar av att skapa trygghet i förändring och skapar gott samverkansklimat med samverkansparter. Det är viktigt att kunna sätta mål, riktning och utveckla enhetens roll i relation till andra enheter på förvaltningen. Särskilt fokus läggs på fritids roll i det förebyggande och främjande arbetet utifrån intentionerna i den nya socialtjänstlagen.KvalifikationerVi söker dig med tidigare erfarenhet från chefstjänst med ansvar för budget, personal och verksamhet. Du har en högskoleexamen inom socialt arbete eller annan högskoleexamen som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant för tjänsten. Det är viktigt att du har en god analytisk förmåga, har god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift samt har stort engagemang i samhällsfrågor. Det är meriterande att ha erfarenhet av ledande funktion i verksamhet för ungdomar.Följande kompetenser ingår i Göteborgs stads ledarkriterier; påverka andra, socialt säker, förändringsorienterad, analytisk förmåga och helhetssyn. Dessa kriterier kommer därför att vara av särskild vikt i urvalsarbete och i intervjusituation.• Du är en tydlig och god kommunikatör som får gehör för tankar och idéer samt har god förmåga att ta andras perspektiv i beaktning. Du kan genom övertygande argument tillföra entusiasm och energi som uppmuntrar goda prestationer, teamkänsla och ökad motivation.• Du är bekväm i sociala kontaktytor, såväl informella som formella. Du står för fattade beslut och kan förmedla obekväma budskap när det behövs.• Du ser möjlighet till utveckling och skapar situationer där nya idéer och förslag kan växa fram. Du motiverar och beskriver förändringar och utvecklingsmöjligheter på ett pedagogiskt vis samt hanterar eventuell kritik mot förändring på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du driver långsiktigt och uthålligt utvecklingsarbete, både på lokal och övergripande nivå.• Du har en god analytisk förmåga och kan snabbt skaffa dig en överblick över situationen och agera utifrån ett strategiskt perspektiv.• Du kan sätta den egna verksamhetens betydelse i ett större sammanhang. Du visar intresse för och samverkar i övergripande frågor för att skapa mervärde. Du tar hänsyn till olika informationskällor och perspektiv samt kan anpassa andras idéer till den egna verksamheten.Som enhetschef har du förmåga att väga samman mål och uppdrag med ett ekonomiskt perspektiv. Du strävar efter att använda befintliga resurser så effektivt som möjligt. För att känna dig trygg i rollen behöver du ha erfarenhet av och förståelse för förutsättningarna i socialt utsatta områden.Välkommen med din ansökan!ÖvrigtFör tjänster som innebär direkt och regelbunden kontakt med barn under 18 år alternativt är i en ledande befattning inom kommun behöver du kunna uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan du börjar arbeta hos oss. Utdraget beställs direkt från Polisens hemsida https://polisen.se/belastningsregistret?mtm_campaign=utdrag&mtm_kwd=post0623Göteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik: Lön, ersättningar och förmåner - Göteborgs StadFör att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen, uppfylla kraven i GDPR samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt och inte via e-post eller brev. Har du skyddade personuppgifter skall du INTE ansöka via systemet utan kontakta rekryterande chef för hantering av din ansökan.Om ossSocialförvaltningen Nordost arbetar för att ge invånare i nordöstra Göteborg en likvärdig och effektiv välfärd med möjlighet att leva trygga och självständiga liv. Förvaltningen ger stöd till individer och familjer enligt Socialtjänstlagen. Vi erbjuder också aktiviteter och mötesplatser som kan ge barn och ungdomar en meningsfull fritid. Dessutom arbetar förvaltningen aktivt med krisstöd, trygghetsfrågor, föreningsliv, folkhälsa samt kontakter med invånare och civilsamhälle.Välkommen till en levande förvaltning i ett dynamiskt stadsområde - här jobbar vi för gemenskap och öppenhet med fokus på dem vi är till för!

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director and lead through an Associate Facility Technical Manager, shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Commercial Director – Defence and Security
jobs.description:
Much of the energy and data Europe depends on travels through cables and pipelines on the seabed. Securing this infrastructure, along with offshore installations, has become a clear priority for defence. DeepOcean has more than 25 years of experience in subsea survey, installation, trenching, inspection, maintenance and repair. We are now setting up a separate defence and security team to offer these services to defence organisations in Norway, the UK, NATO and allied countries.

We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead our sales and bid work in this market. As the team is newly established, you will be starting from scratch.  You will decide which customers to focus on, build the relationships and lead the bids through to signed contracts. You will report to the Director of the DeepOcean defence team and join a small team with real freedom to shape how the business develops. You will need to be hands-on yourself and gradually build the team required to handle the growth in the unit.

The role is based in Norway and involves regular travel to customers, partners and our sites in Norway, the UK and internationally. Applications will be handled confidentially.  

Your key responsibilities:

  • Map the defence market and build our pipeline – Norwegian Armed Forces and Forsvarsmateriell, NATO and NATO agencies, UK MOD and the Royal Navy, allied nations and the major defence primes – and decide where we can realistically win.
  • Build and maintain the relationships that give us access, from programme owners and capability planners to partners and primes, and put the teaming agreements and partnerships in place that let us compete.
  • Lead capture and bids end to end: the bid/no-bid call, the win strategy, shaping the solution with our engineers and operators, pricing it, writing it, submitting it and defending it.
  • Secure our licence to bid – supplier registrations, prequalifications, frameworks and the compliance groundwork a new defence entity needs before anyone will take its offer seriously.
  • Negotiate terms and commercial risk through to contract, then hand the work over cleanly to the delivery organisation.
  • Build the commercial function itself – pipeline reporting, bid process, win/loss discipline – and grow a small commercial and bid team as the business scales.

 

Experience and qualifications:

  • 7–10 years in business development, capture or commercial roles, with significant time spent selling into or working within defence.
  • An active, current network in Norwegian defence (Forsvaret, Forsvarsmateriell, FFI) and/or NATO, UK MOD or allied defence organisations.
  • Practical experience of public and defence procurement – tender requirements, framework competitions, evaluation criteria – and of negotiating commercial terms and risk.
  • A degree in engineering, business or economics, or a military academy background. Strong, directly relevant experience can replace formal qualifications.
  • Eligible for Norwegian and NATO security clearance. You do not need to hold a clearance today – but should be able to receive a clearance when needed.
  • A background in subsea, maritime, offshore or naval work is an advantage.

 

Personal qualifications:

  • You are a self-starter who is comfortable without a playbook, and you would rather build the function than inherit it.
  • You have commercial judgement and the nerve to use it – you know which opportunities to walk away from, and you can make that case internally.
  • You write well and present well, and you hold your own in front of senior military and industry people.
  • You play the long game when it comes to relationships, in a market where decisions can take years.
  • You are resilient and organised, and you can run several bids to fixed deadlines without dropping any of them.
  • You are curious about the technology, enough to explain to a customer what our capability actually does for them.

Our values are important to us, and we are therefore looking for people who identify with them: We ACT with a can-do Attitude. We ACT with the Courage to embrace new challenges, stop unsafe practices, always be compliant and shift boundaries through innovative solutions. And we ACT as one Team.

 

Why will you enjoy working with us?

  • A fast-paced and team-oriented work environment – we have fun at work!
  • Varied challenges, great development opportunities, and the chance to make an impact in a global organization.
  • Favorable travel insurance (including family members), health insurance, and pension plans (including AFP), as well as subsidies for physical activity.
  • Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance, so you can thrive both at work and at home.
  • And for this role in particular: a rare opportunity to build a new business from the ground up, with the resources, track record and engineering depth of an established international subsea company behind you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and workplace. We value inclusion, equality and diversity and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

DeepOcean is a technology-driven, independent solution provider in the ocean space. We offer companies within oil and gas, offshore renewables, deep sea minerals, and other non-energy niches a full range of services – from surveys, engineering, project management and installation to maintenance and recycling.

Our global team of experts is at the forefront of remote and unmanned operations and digitally-enabled services. Supported by an extensive tool and technology pool, they drive cost-efficient, safe and sustainable operations. DeepOcean has a GO GREEN attitude, continuously looking to make our customers’ operations more sustainable, through reducing both carbon footprint and costs.  

A world-leading ocean services provider, DeepOcean enables the energy transition and sustainable use of ocean resources. People are the heart of our operations. It’s about technology, systems, and processes, but in the end, it is our people that deliver the services.

jobs.title: À la carte kock / À la carte chef
jobs.description: På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet för större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för en vintersäsong i norr med storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter. Som medarbetare i vårt kök på Camp Ripan är du en stor del av det som gör att gästerna får en minnesvärd matupplevelse utöver det vanliga hoa oss. Här representeras vår trekulturella region i form av noggrant utvalda råvaror i spännande smakkombinationer. Camp Ripans kök är ett av Sveriges mest klimatsmarta kök, här arbetar vi med den senaste tekniken för att minimera vår påverkan på miljön. Vi söker nu dig som trivs med att jobba i ett drivet arbetslag, där alla deltar och påverkar den kreativa processen, från idé till färdig produkt. Du har ett levande intresse för yrket, minst 6 års erfarenhet (3 år utbildning, 3 år av arbetslivserfarenhet i à la carterestaurang), goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper inom den lokala matkulturen och dess råvaror eftersom det är grunden i vår matfilosofi.  Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov. Särskild visstidsanställning på 100%. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten.  At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service, and respect for one another are fundamental.At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner, as well as hosting larger events and gatherings. Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Knowledge of local food culture and regional ingredients is considered an advantage, as these form the foundation of our culinary philosophy.Staff accommodation is available if needed. This is a full-time temporary position (100%). Interviews are conducted continuously, and employment will begin once we have found the right candidate for the position.

jobs.title: Business Transformation Analyst
jobs.description: Join our global company powered by ambitious people that are truly passionate about making a positive difference in food. Together we strive to achieve our vision of becoming Nordic’s leading food company. With business in mind and people at heart we always work together to influence our road ahead – and we want you to be a part of our journey!An exciting opportunity has arisen at Lantmännen Cerealia for a Business Transformation Analyst to join us at our office in Stockholm.This is what you will doThis role supports the newly created Chief Business Transformation Office in shaping and executing strategic growth initiatives with a particular focus on mergers and acquisitions. The position combines market scanning, business case development and first integration planning to ensure that strategic opportunities are translated into value-creating outcomes for Lantmännen Cerealia.The Business Transformation Analyst is supporting the identification, assessment and advancing of inorganic growth opportunities in line with Cerealia’s strategic priorities. Reporting to the Chief Business Transformation Officer, the role supports the development of M&A target pipelines, builds robust business cases, participates in due diligence workstreams, and supports the first phases of post-deal integration to secure value capture and business continuity.Key Responsibilities:    In collaboration with LM Group M&A team and/or external advisors, support the screening of potential targets using strategic, commercial, operational, and financial criteria, including market attractiveness, channel fit, capabilities, and synergy potential.    Through external support, monitor market trends, category developments, competitor moves, and ownership changes to proactively identify actionable inorganic growth opportunities.    Collaborate in developing robust business cases for prioritized opportunities, including strategic rationale, valuation logic, synergy assumptions, risks, investment requirements, and integration implications.    Prepare decision material for senior management and governance forums, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations and decision points.    Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to challenge assumptions, test scenarios, and ensure that business cases are grounded in realistic value-creation plans.    Support transaction planning and execution in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external advisors, ensuring timely preparation of analyses, materials, and management recommendations.    Track integration risks, dependencies, and value-capture progress during the initial integration period, escalating key issues and proposing corrective actions where neededYou are:    highly analytical, with a structured approach to solving complex business problems.    financially and commercially minded, comfortable developing business cases and evaluating value-creation opportunities.    curious about markets and businesses, with a strong interest in identifying and assessing growth and M&A opportunities.    a clear communicator, able to turn complex analyses into simple insights, recommendations, and decision material.    well organized and delivery-focused, able to coordinate multiple activities, stakeholders, and deadlines.    proactive and accountable, taking ownership and moving work forward with limited supervision.    constructively challenging, comfortable questioning assumptions while remaining pragmatic and solution-oriented.    collaborative and low-ego, building effective relationships across functions, seniority levels, and external partners.    comfortable with ambiguity, able to create structure and maintain momentum when not all answers are available.    detail-oriented while keeping the bigger picture in mind, connecting analysis and execution to strategic value creation.You share our values - Openness, Holistic view, Drive - and our promise of taking responsibility from Field to Fork.What we offer youAt Lantmännen, you work on things that matter. Together, we develop sustainable solutions for the future of farming, food, and energy. As an international group with operations in different markets and industries, we can offer a diverse range of development opportunities. Here, there is always more to explore.With business in mind and people at heart, we actively aim for a culture where people can grow, collaborate and make a real impact. Internal mobility and continuous development are natural parts of how we grow - both our business and as employees.That is how we make it matter, from field to fork.Sounds interesting?We hope so! We are working with ongoing selection which means that this position can be filled before the last application date. So don’t wait too long to apply!Lantmännen Cerealia is part of Lantmännen, an agricultural cooperative and Northern Europe’s leader in agriculture, bioenergy and food products. Owned by 17,000 Swedish farmers, Lantmännen has more than 10,000 employees, operations in over 20 countries and an annual turnover of SEK 60 billion. With grain at the heart of the operations, Lantmännen refine arable land resources to make farming thrive. Some of Lantmännen’s best-known food brands are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, GoGreen, FINN CRISP, Schulstad and Vaasan. The company is founded on the knowledge and values acquired through generations of farmers. By engaging in research, development and operations throughout the value chain, Lantmännen takes responsibility from field to fork. More about LantmännenLantmännen Cerealia develops, produces and markets a large range of healthy and nutritious food, based on local farmland resources. The core of our assortment is grain-based products, including flour, oats, muesli, crisp bread, pasta and pancakes, but we also provide a range of green foods. Kungsörnen, AXA, Start!, FINN CRISP, Amo, Regal

jobs.title: Heimetenesta
jobs.description:
Om avdelinga: 

Vår visjon er å skape framtidas heimeteneste – ei teneste som er heilskapleg, førebyggjande og tett på brukarane. No etablerer vi eit nytt team i tenesta. Vi søkjer fagpersonar som vil vere med og forme gode pasient- og brukarforløp.

Arbeidet vårt er forankra i verdiane omsorg, livsglede, mot, rausheit og engasjement – verdiar vi ønskjer skal vere tydelege i møte med brukarar, pårørande og kollegaer.

Om innsatsteamet:

Teamet skal arbeide tidsavgrensa og intensivt med brukarar som har behov for kartlegging, oppfølging og rehabilitering i heimen. Teamet får ei sentral rolle i å følgje opp, støtte og trygge brukarar i overgangar mellom sjukehus, korttidsopphald og heim.

Gjennom tett samhandling skal teamet mellom anna bidra til:

  • gode og samanhengande pasient- og brukarforløp
  • trygg start heime etter utskriving
  • styrke meistring, funksjon og livskvalitet
  • redusert behov for reinnlegging og meir varige tenester

Innsatsteamet består av tre faste stillingar, 2 stillingar som avansert klinisk allmennsjukepleiar og 1 stilling som fysioterapeut. Vi har 1 ledig stilling som avansert klinisk allmennsjukepleiar.

Arbeidsoppgåver:
  • Samhandle tett med sjukehus, korttidavdeling, fastlege, heimetenesta og andre samarbeidspartnarar
  • Følgje brukarar i overgangar mellom sjukehus, korttidsopphald og heim
  • Karleggje funksjon, helsetilstand, ressursar og behov
  • Drive heimerehabilitering med fokus på meistring, sjølvstende og livsglede
  • Trygge brukarar og pårørande i sårbare fasar
  • Nytta velferdsteknologiske løysingar
  • Bidra i førebyggjande og helsefremmjande arbeid
  • Vere med å utvikle strukturar, arbeidsformer og innhald i det nye teamet
  • Andre oppgåver kan bli tillagt stillinga
Kvalifikasjonar:
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sjukepleiar med master i avansert klinisk allmennsjukepleie (AKS) eller påbegynt master
  • Førarkort klasse B. Ein må kunne nytta eigen bil ved behov
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Fordel med erfaring frå heimetenesta, rehabilitering og/eller spesialisthelsetenesta
Personlege eigenskapar:
  • Du er sjøvstendig, fagleg trygg og viser mot i rolla di
  • Du er kreativ, løysingsorientert og open for nye måtar å arbeide på 
  • Du har eit heilskapleg blikk på pasient- og brukarforløp
  • Du er raus i samarbeid og bidreg aktivt inn i teamet
  • Du møtar brukarar og pårørande med omsorg, engasjement og respekt
  • Du jobbar etter prinsippet "Kva er viktig for deg?" og set brukaren sine mål og ressursar i sentrum
Vi tilbyr:
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
  • Motiverte og kunnskapsrike kollegaer
  • Interessante utfordringar
  • Høve til fagleg og personleg utvikling
  • Moglegheit til å vere med å byggje og forme framtidas heimeteneste
  • Ein meiningsfull arbeidskvardag der verdiane våre er levande i praksis
  • Stor fagleg påverknad og rom for utvikling
  • Eit inkluderande, tverrfagleg og engasjert arbeidsmiljø
  • Moglegheit for startlån, meir informasjon fins på heimesida til kommunen Startlån og tilskot til etablering - Øygarden kommune
Kontakt: 

Ass. Einingsleiar heimetenesta: Kate Samland Løland

Tlf: +47 56 16 05 02 | +47 950 71 121

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. 

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: CNC-operatör till avancerad bearbetning
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Vill du arbeta med avancerad bearbetning, moderna maskiner och produkter som används över hela världen?Hos Epiroc i Kalmar får du mer än bara ett jobb vid maskinen. Du får arbeta i en högteknologisk produktionsmiljö där din yrkesskicklighet värdesätts, där kvalitet och säkerhet alltid går först – och där du som erfaren CNC‑operatör verkligen kan göra skillnad.Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.Bli en del av vårt teamVi befinner oss i en tillväxtfas och söker nu skickliga CNC‑operatörer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens produktion tillsammans med oss. Här finns långsiktighet, stabilitet och utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som vill ta nästa steg – hos ett företag som satsar på framtiden.Epiroc i Kalmar tillverkar världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv‑ och anläggningsindustrin – och nu breddar och vidareutvecklar vi vårt produktutbud. Det innebär investeringar i ny teknik, automation, och nya metoder för bearbetning och värmebehandling. Nyfiken på att bli med på resan? Läs mer om Epiroc i Kalmar här.Ditt uppdrag Som CNC‑operatör hos oss får du arbeta med komponenter och produkter där kraven på precision, kvalitet och spårbarhet är höga. Det du tillverkar används i krävande miljöer världen över – vilket ställer höga krav, men också ger en tydlig stolthet i arbetet.Maskinbearbetningen bedrivs i moderna fleroperationsmaskiner och svarvar, och kommer inom kort även att omfatta slipning. I rollen ingår ett helhetsansvar för dina maskiner och arbeten, vilket bland annat innebär:     Självständig körning och övervakning av CNC‑maskiner     Planering av det dagliga arbetet och hantering av tillverkningsorder     Verktygshantering och processnära kvalitetsarbete     Daglig tillsyn av maskiner, utrustning och arbetsmiljö Din profilVi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs i en miljö där teknik, problemlösning och ständig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Ditt intresse och engagemang för bearbetning gör att du gärna delar med dig av din erfarenhet, testar nya arbetssätt och bidrar till ett stabilt och effektivt produktionsflöde, alltid med stort fokus på säkerhet och kvalitet.Vi ser gärna att du har:     Erfarenhet av arbete som CNC‑operatör, alternativt relevant CNC‑utbildning kombinerad med praktisk erfarenhet     God datorvana för dokumentation, rapportering och produktionsuppföljning     Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift Vill du utvecklas vidare inom skärande bearbetning och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens produktion med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.Placering och arbetstiderDenna tjänst är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Arbetet är förlagt till kontinuerligt skiftarbete, vilket innebär att du behöver vara flexibel och trivas med ett rullande schema.Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:     Globala karriärmöjligheter.     Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.     Samhällsengagemang.     Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus. Ansökan och kontaktinformationDu ansöker på vår karriärsida, genom att ladda upp ditt CV (personligt brev behövs ej) och svara på några korta frågor. Ansökningar granskas löpande och vi uppmuntrar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast den 30 september 2026.Har du frågor om tjänsten, välkommen att kontakta oss:Tekla Brunetto, Rekryteringsspecialist, tekla.brunetto@external.epiroc.com.Ibro Lindh, Produktionsledare, ibro.lindh@epiroc.com.Vänligen observera att vi inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.Välkommen med din ansökan!
