We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten.

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen.

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken!

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer.   • leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht.

En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:

  • lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Binnen dit team werken collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden samen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor het spoor. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken werkomgeving waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, ideeën te toetsen en jouw resultaten te bespreken met ervaren collega's. jobs.title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
jobs.description:
Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing.

Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

YOU

  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau;

  • Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels;

  • Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

  • Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief;

  • Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen;

  • Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt).



OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving;

  • Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent;

  • De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen;

  • De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers;

  • Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback;

  • Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand;

  • Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie.


KEUNE

We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter.

jobs.title: Stage consultancy in het publieke domein
jobs.description:
24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship.

Dit ga je doen

Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door:

  • Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies.

  • Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen.

  • Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken.

  • Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk.

  • Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties.

Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa.

Quote

"De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega's

Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen.

Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties.


Dit neem je mee

  • Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker!

  • Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen.

  • Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • Een laptop.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Mariëlle Boer. Vragen? Neem contact op met Mariëlle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10487159) of per mail ().

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Florian Rosenmöller beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Bel of WhatsApp Florian Rosenmöller via (06 30364562). of stuur een e-mail naar

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Als senior consultant financiën overheid werk je aan diverse opdrachten binnen de publieke sector, met een focus op financiële vraagstukken bij gemeenten, provincies en het Rijk. Je ondersteunt overheden bij het op orde brengen en houden van hun financiën en zorgt ervoor dat zij grip krijgen op hun begroting. Daarbij ben je breed inzetbaar en krijg je de kans om nieuwe onderwerpen op te pakken. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn onder andere:

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale tools en AI-toepassingen binnen financiën.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de groei en ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep door jouw commerciële vaardigheden en netwerk.

Quote

‘Overheden staan voor complexe financiële uitdagingen. Samen met mijn collega's help ik hen om grip te krijgen op hun financiën en strategische keuzes te maken die écht impact hebben.’ – Senior managing consultant financiën Openbaar Bestuur

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Je maakt deel uit van het team Financiën, bedrijfsvoering en control, binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de verantwoorde en effectieve besteding van publieke middelen. Je werkt in een hecht en gezellig team van ervaren consultants en experts, waar samenwerken en kennisdeling centraal staan.

De adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur bestaat uit ongeveer honderd adviseurs met ieder hun eigen specialisatie. Er werken financieel deskundigen, crisis- en veiligheidsexperts, bestuurskundigen, juristen, politicologen, experts binnen de kunst- en cultuursector en communicatiespecialisten. We zijn een jonge, eigenzinnige club die in wisselende samenstellingen aan projecten werkt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. jobs.description: ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist for a Global Engineering Environment in LinköpingDescriptionWe are looking for a consultant to take overall responsibility for EPLAN within an international, technology-focused organisation. The assignment combines an understanding of electrical design with application management, user support and the development of working practices. You do not need to know every aspect from day one, but you should understand EPLAN and be able to drive initiatives in collaboration with users, IT and other technical teams.About the assignmentAs ECAD Tool Owner, you will have global responsibility for managing and further developing the EPLAN environment. The role combines technical and coordination responsibilities: gathering business requirements, leading discussions with key users and ensuring that tools, guidelines and integrations evolve in a structured way.A key part of the assignment is the integration between EPLAN and Teamcenter via XPLM. You will take the lead on project activities related to this integration, including planning user testing and introducing the solution to different user groups. An electrical designer already provides backup support for administration and ongoing project activities, creating a solid foundation for handover and collaboration.Your responsibilities will include:    Acting as the global administrator and Tool Owner for EPLAN.    Leading and developing the organisation’s key user community.    Gathering requirements, improvement suggestions and user feedback.    Planning and implementing EPLAN updates.    Creating and maintaining guidelines and shared working practices.    Managing licences and related application management activities.    Taking responsibility for the EPLAN infrastructure in collaboration with IT.    Supporting key users and helping resolve issues efficiently.    Taking ownership of the XPLM interface between EPLAN and Teamcenter.    Leading projects related to the further development and rollout of the integration.    Planning user testing and introducing new solutions to the relevant users.Your profileYou have worked in electrical design and have practical experience with EPLAN. Your background may include roles such as electrical designer, EPLAN administrator, application specialist, CAD/ECAD coordinator or application manager. What matters most is that you understand users’ day-to-day work and can take clear ownership of tool-related matters.You should be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating activities and driving initiatives forward with multiple stakeholders. The role suits someone who is structured, communicative and solution-oriented, with the ability to move between technical details and a broader application management perspective.Mandatory requirements    Experience in electrical design.    Practical experience with EPLAN.    Ability to gather requirements and plan and drive activities.    Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written.Desirable qualifications    Experience in EPLAN administration or application management.    Experience with Teamcenter.    Experience with XPLM or similar integrations between ECAD and PLM systems.    Experience with system upgrades, user testing or rollouts to multiple user groups.    Experience leading key user networks or working in an international organisation.Assignment detailsAssignment type: Consultancy assignmentWorkload: Full-time, 100%Location: Linköping, on-siteStart date: As soon as possibleAssignment duration: Six-month periodsExtension: Good prospects for extensionLanguage: Spoken and written English requiredWhy this assignment is interestingThis role offers significant practical influence over a core engineering design tool within a global technology organisation. You will work closely with electrical design teams, users and IT while driving an important integration between ECAD and PLM. The combination of technical depth, international collaboration and clear ownership makes this assignment particularly relevant for a consultant looking to move from a dedicated design role into tool ownership and technical application management.

jobs.title: Lead Developer
jobs.description: Looking for a workplace for the future?We are looking for a Lead developer for our Online Sales team, enabling all digital sales journeys on Telenor.se. You will guide and lead highly skilled developers operating in a complex landscape; balancing team growth, AI adoption, technical evolution, and customer experience improvements. We are looking for someone who holds a deep conceptual understanding of frontend software development, but you will also be expected to do hands-on work yourself. We believe the correct person for this role and team is both a leader, mentor and a doer.How you’ll make a difference with us    Leadership: You will be accountable for the technical excellence of the team, including code quality. However, there are many ways to lead and at Telenor we promote strength-based leadership and servant leadership.     Team Management & Growth: At Telenor we believe we are Better Together. You're expected to help your colleagues learn and grow, for example through individual feedback, mentoring and pair programming.     Stability & reliability: Telenor provides services that are vital for our society. Because of this an important responsibility for this role to ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms.     In-team collaboration: You'll be one of the informal leaders of the team, together with the Agile Team Lead and the Product Owner, whom you'll be expected to collaborate closely with.     Cross-team collaboration: You'll work closely with architects, UX, content creators and other development teams. Are you the one we’re looking for?We are looking for someone comfortable working with most of our current technologies, who can work within our architectural principles and help evolve them through thoughtful discussion and practical experience. We are looking for someone familiar with the following technologies.Frontend Development    Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript and frontend frameworks (e.g. Vue).     Microfrontend architectures and components patterns.     Design Systems, component libraries.    Responsive design and browser compatibility. Backend Development    Strong expertise in .NET/C# web application development.     Third-party system integrations (REST APIs and GraphQL).     Headless CMS architecture (Contentful).  Testing & Quality    TDD and quality-first development.     Clean code, maintainability and engineering best practices. Cloud, DevOps & Observability     Cloud platforms (AWS).     Distributed caching strategies (Redis).     CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).     Observability and performance analysis (ELK, Splunk, Elastic APM). Accessibility     WCAG, semantic HTML and inclusive design.     Accessibility testing and compliance. Security    Security best practices.     Secure coding and privacy by design. Good-to-have    E-commerce and digital sales flows.    Feature management and experimentation platforms.     AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). Our promise to you! We are better together. Here, you’ll join an inclusive, family-like culture where shared values and empowering leadership build trust, confidence, and mutual support.We support relationships and societies. Telenor serves society by creating value for millions daily, putting customers and human relationships first.We make room for life. Work remotely up to two days a week when your role allows, and collaborate at the office otherwise. Enjoy two extra days off yearly, flexible hours, and benefits for every life stage, including collective agreements, pensions, wellness allowances, and tailored insurance.Move your career forward. Your growth is central to our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours yearly to learning through Telenor Academy and other initiatives, helping you build expertise, explore new areas, and advance your career across the Nordics.Apply today!At Telenor we offer an environment with a high pace of change, great colleagues and lots of opportunities for learning and growth. Apply now!If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Jakob Grefbäck at jakob.grefback@telenor.se . Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. The team is responsible for optimizing process performance, supporting safe and stable operations, and driving continuous improvements across our hydrogen production and direct reduction plants.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very few silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Provide day-to-day process engineering support to ensure safe, stable, and efficient plant operations.    Monitor plant performance, troubleshoot process upsets, and lead root cause analyses to improve reliability and operational excellence.    Optimize process performance through process modelling, heat and mass balances, debottlenecking, and energy efficiency initiatives.    Support direct reduction operations during commissioning, start-ups, shutdowns, and operational changes.    Review and develop engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, SOPs, and process control strategies.    Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, and OEM partners to improve process performance and implement engineering solutions.    Drive continuous improvement projects, monitor production KPIs, and prepare technical reports to support data-driven decision-making.    Promote safe operations by supporting process safety activities, hydrogen safety standards, PTW/LOTO compliance, and technical training.What you'll bringYou're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking—and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we'd like to see that you bring:    A degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.    Solid process engineering experience from an operating, commercial-scale Direct Reduction plant.    Experience supporting commissioning, start-ups, process optimization, or operational improvements in an industrial setting.    A strong understanding of process engineering fundamentals, with the ability to analyse complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions.    Experience with hydrogen production is a plus. Curiosity about the hydrogen process and a willingness to learn are important.    Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Engineering, and external partners to achieve shared goals.    A proactive, structured, and safety-first approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

jobs.title: DCEO Engr 3
jobs.description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity. Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value. Key job responsibilities You will also be involved in: o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support. o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators. o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment. o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary. o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems. In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!A day in the lifeDay to day activities for this role include; o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center. o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained. o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works. o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties. o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover. o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development. o Event response and drill participation. About the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.Basic Qualifications- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience- 2+ years of relevant work experience- Strong English verbal and written communication skillsPreferred Qualifications- Experience in data center engineeringAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes – ett meningsfullt extrajobb utanför Norrtälje
jobs.description: Är du en omtänksam och ansvarstagande person med humor och energi? Söker du ett meningsfullt extrajobb där du får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Rollen passar dig som tycker om att arbeta nära en annan människa och som förstår värdet av trygghet, kontinuitet och en god relation.Tjänsten omfattar:Arbete varannan helg, totalt cirka 13 timmar, samt kvällar och extrapass enligt överenskommelse och efter behov. Viss flexibilitet i arbetstiderna, där planeringen kan göras tillsammans.Det här kan vara ett perfekt extrajobb för dig som exempelvis studerar, har en annan deltidsanställning eller söker ett meningsfullt arbete vid sidan av din huvudsakliga sysselsättning.Vem söker vi?Vi tror att du är en person som:Är 40 år eller äldreÄr omtänksam, vänlig och ansvarstagandeHar humor, energi och ett positivt förhållningssättÄr lyhörd och trygg i mötet med andra människorGärna delar ett intresse för sportTalar svenskaHar erfarenhet från hemtjänst, omsorg eller liknande arbete.Har körkort och tillgång till bil, vilket är meriterande med tanke på arbetsplatsens lägeVi erbjuder digEn trygg introduktion så att du får goda förutsättningar att komma in i rollenStöd och vägledning i ditt arbeteEtt meningsfullt extrajobb där din personlighet och ditt engagemang verkligen gör skillnadMöjlighet till extra arbete vid behovDet viktigaste är att ni trivs tillsammansVi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och personkemi. För oss är det viktigaste inte att du har ett långt CV, utan att du är rätt person för uppdraget. Du behöver vara pålitlig, engagerad och vilja bidra till en trygg, positiv och meningsfull vardag.________________________________________📩 Välkommen med din ansökan!🌱 För att trivas hos ossFör att trivas och växa i rollen som personlig assistent behöver du ha en välgrundad människosyn där alla människors lika värde är en självklarhet.Du har mod, engagemang och en vilja att göra skillnad för någon annan.God självkännedom, lyhördhet och flexibilitet är också viktiga egenskaper.🏢 Om Aberia Personlig AssistansVi är arbetsgivaren som är små nog att vara nära – och stora nog att göra skillnad.Hos oss får du en närvarande chef, stöd i ditt dagliga arbete, handledning, friskvård, kollektivavtal och en mängd utbildningsmöjligheter.🌍 Vår verksamhetVåra kunder finns i hela Sverige – barn, unga, vuxna, familjer och kommuner.🌐 En del av något störreAberia är en del av NHC Group, en nordisk koncern med bred kompetens inom LSS, personlig assistans, förskolor och äldreomsorg.

jobs.title: Hotellchef
jobs.description: Livington hotel ligger i vinsta.Vi letar efter en hotellchef som har erfarenhet och villutveckla hotellet, konferensen och restaurangen.Söker du en roll med stort ansvar och blandade arbetsuppgifterär detta den perfekta tjänsten för dig. Tjänsten är tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning.Heltid på rullande schema inklusive kvällar/helger.Fast grundlön

jobs.title: Team Member Opportunity (Attendant) - World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2027
jobs.description:
We are seeking motivated individuals to join our team for the prestigious World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting 2027 in Davos. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a global event that shapes the world's economic and political landscape.

Event Details:

  • Date: January 18.01. - 22.01.2027
    depending on the team: arrival 14th or 16th January 2027

  • Location: Davos, Switzerland

  • Important: Application evenings on 2nd November, 13th November or 23rd November (Zurich), and 17th November (Lausanne)

Attendance at one of the application evenings is mandatory and must take place in person. Unfortunately, online participation is not possible.

Tasks

  • Badge issuance at registration desks

  • Access control at lounges and sessions

  • Assisting in the congress center and surrounding hotels

Requirements

  • Minimum age of 18 years

  • Valid work permit for Switzerland

  • Excellent English language skills (C1 level or higher)

  • Available for the entire duration: minimum 16. - 22.01.2027

  • Maintaining a professional and courteous demeanor at all times

  • Discreet, committed, and able to work under pressure

  • Polite and courteous attitude

  • You must bring your own black shoes (professional shoes: 2-4 cm heel, no patent leather)

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Accommodation provided (unless you have your own in Davos or Klosters)

  • Meals included

  • Uniform provided (suit/dress and stockings)

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates

jobs.title: Tullverket söker gruppchef till uppbördsavdelningen
jobs.description: Vill du arbeta med internationell handel och hjälpa företag att göra rätt i sin tullhantering? Tullverket har ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag med visionen ”bara godkända varor över gränsen” vilket innebär att endast lagliga och deklarerade varor passerar våra gränser. Vårt mål är att skapa ett tryggare samhälle, ökad tillväxt och välfärd samt konkurrens på lika villkor. Hos oss får du också bidra till att bekämpa organiserad brottslighet och den kriminella ekonomin. Vi söker just nu en gruppchef som är redo att göra skillnad! Vill du vara med på resan?Nu söker vi en gruppchef till uppbördsenhet nord i Sundsvall. Enheten består av två grupper och leds av en enhetschef. I den här rollen ansvarar du och din grupp bland annat för underlag till handelsstatistik och redovisning av Sveriges tullintäkter till EU-kommissionen. Gruppen arbetar även med kvalitetsgranskning och stöttar andra funktioner inom Tullverket med exempelvis fördjupade solvensbedömningar av företag. Mycket samverkan sker med enhetens andra grupp, som främst arbetar med betalningshantering och oreglerade fodringar, handläggning och övervakning av tillstånd för företag. Inom enheten deltar medarbetare även i utvecklingsarbete för att kontinuerligt förbättra och utveckla våra tjänster.Som gruppchef ansvar du för att nå uppsatta mål och förväntat resultat i enlighet med beslutade processer och strategiska inriktningar. Tillsammans med enhetschefen och gruppchefen för den andra gruppen bildar ni ett team som styr och utvecklar uppbördsenhet nord. Uppbördsavdelningens operativa arbete bedrivs inom fyra enheter med flexibla grupper, vilket gör att samverkan med andra gruppchefer är en naturlig del av vardagen.     Om tjänsten Som gruppchef är du ansvarig för medarbetarna, verksamheten och arbetsmiljön i din grupp. Du fattar löpande olika former av myndighetsbeslut. Samverkan med övriga gruppchefer inom avdelningen är en del av vardagen och en förutsättning för att kunna leda och styra arbetet.Gruppen består idag av ca 12 medarbetare, både handläggare och verksamhetsexperter. Då vissa medarbetare är placerade på annan ort blir det även aktuellt med distansledarskap i din chefsroll. Du ingår i enhetens chefsgrupp och rapporterar löpande till ansvarig enhetschef för uppbördsenhet nord som också är din närmaste chef.Tullverkets verksamhet är komplex och i ständig utveckling. Förbättringsarbete är en del av vardagen. Att vara chef på uppbördsavdelningen ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och lyhördhet. Är du den vi söker?   Vi söker dig som har:    Akademisk examen inom t ex ekonomi, statsvetenskap, beteendevetenskap eller juridik, alternativt motsvarande utbildning och erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig    Flerårig chefserfarenhet med personalansvar och/eller flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom Tullverkets fiskala verksamhet    God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift såväl på svenska som engelska    Svenskt medborgarskapDet är meriterande om du har:    Chef- och/eller ledarskapsutbildning    Väl dokumenterad chefserfarenhet inom statlig verksamhet    Väl dokumenterad erfarenhet av kvalificerad handläggning och utredningsarbete inom myndighet    Erfarenhet av att utveckla verksamhet och leda i förändring    Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoderPersonliga egenskaper     Mod – att fatta och fullfölja beslut, ta tag i utmaningar och pröva nya idéer    God kommunikativ förmåga – som tydliggör inriktning och ramar, och skapar mening och samförstånd genom inkluderande, inlyssnande och engagerande dialog    Psykologisk trygghet – i termer av integritet och förmåga att hantera såväl egna som andras reaktioner, tankar och känslor    Nyfikenhet och prestigelöshet – genom att utforska och utmana sig själv och andra i att tänka nytt och göra annorlunda i syfte att stimulera lärande och innovation    Ha förmåga att tillvarata mångfald – vad gäller kompetens, erfarenheter och perspektiv för att utveckla verksamheten och hantera den ökande komplexiteten vi agerar i    Positiv människosyn – med intresse för människor och deras utveckling    Samarbetsförmåga – säkerställa god samverkan inom gruppen och i relation till andra grupper och enheter    Ha förmåga att aktivt arbeta för en god arbetsmiljö    Gott omdöme – kunna uppträda som en god representant för Tullverket såväl intern som externtEn självklarhet är att arbeta enligt Tullverkets värdeord: ansvarstagande, nytänkande och helhetssyn.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet!Vi erbjuder digGenom att jobba på Tullverket har du ett viktigt arbete där du bidrar till ett tryggt och säkert samhälle. Vi värderar trivsel och kompetensutveckling högt och vi strävar efter att du som anställd hos oss ska kunna ha en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid. Hos oss får du trygga anställningsvillkor och våra förmåner omfattar bland annat friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerade läkemedel och goda semester- och pensionsvillkor.Övrigt:Referensnummer: TV-2026-24475Placeringsort: SundsvallAnställningsform: Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning och inleds med 6 månaders provanställning. security, data protection, and AI governance.    Conduct structured handovers at the beginning and end of the assignment.What You Bring    Several years of experience leading AI, data, or platform English.Meritorious    Experience implementing enterprise-wide AI adoption programs.    Experience with AI agent platforms and AI gateways.    Experience evaluating and governing enterprise AI tools.    Experience leading AI transformation initiatives in international organizations.Top 3 Required Skills    Enterprise AI program leadership and roadmap management.    Generative AI, AI agents, With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Backend Developer / Engineer for a consulting assignment within a team responsible for release management of the organization’s primary applications. The mission is to enhance and streamline the release process through improved monitoring, automation, and quality assurance.The organization is transitioning from Jira to a new tool and needs to establish a separate database for release tracking. The consultant will analyze dependencies and automation flows between Jira projects and release tools, then design and implement an appropriate technical solution. A central part of the assignment is the continued development of an existing dashboard into a unified decision-support solution. It will provide clear performance and stability metrics, defined thresholds, and quality gates with approved, warning, and blocked status levels.The solution must guide release managers toward clear next steps and automatically create issues and send notifications when deviations occur, without negatively affecting release cadence. Initial support will cover the organization’s most important Android and iOS applications, with the possibility of future expansion.Key Responsibilities    Analyze dependencies, integrations, and automation flows between Jira projects and release management tools.    Design and implement a separate database and supporting technical solution for release tracking.    Enhance an existing dashboard into a consolidated decision-support tool for release stakeholders.    Implement metrics for application performance and stability, including thresholds and quality gates.    Provide actionable guidance for release managers based on approved, warning, and blocked status levels.    Automate issue creation and notifications when release metrics or quality indicators deviate from defined thresholds.    Develop end-to-end functionality across backend and frontend components.    Collaborate closely with release managers, data scientists, and release engineers to translate operational needs into usable technical solutions.    Ensure that delivered code is tested, maintainable, and thoroughly documented for ongoing support and development.    Work independently within large, established codebases and deliver useful results from the beginning of the assignment.Technical Stack & Requirements    Backend: Strong development expertise in Java and Python.    APIs and services: Experience designing services and developing REST or gRPC APIs.    Frontend: Practical experience with React and TypeScript.    Data-intensive interfaces: Experience building user-friendly internal tools and dashboards that process or present large data volumes.    Release tooling: Experience analyzing and automating workflows involving Jira and release management platforms.    Mobile delivery: Knowledge of release processes for Android and iOS applications is advantageous.    CI/CD: Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery tools is preferred.    Backstage: Previous experience developing Backstage plugins is advantageous.Qualifications & ExperienceA minimum of five years of software development experience is required, together with documented success delivering full-stack functionality from initial design through production-ready implementation. The consultant must be comfortable entering large, existing codebases, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and working independently with limited guidance. Strong product understanding is required, including the ability to translate ambiguous processes and stakeholder needs into simple, practical tools. The role also requires effective written and verbal communication and experience collaborating across multiple teams.
